If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Despite high disapproval for President Joe Biden in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi, Democrats outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**May 12, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
Today, kids across the country made handmade cards, cooked up a breakfast in bed and tried to tiptoe around the house to let their precious mommas get a bit more sleep. It's the day of the year we celebrate the hard-working, loving, ever-giving matriarch of the family: Mother's Day!
Moms have been in the eye of the storm the last few years, navigating the upheaval in our lives from the aftermath of Covid, managing slim budgets because of inflation and helping our children facing mental health issues at record rates. Moms have also been a force to be reckoned with politically, fiercely advocating for our kids around education, healthcare, woke craziness and a society that doesn't want us parents in control.
The women of Colorado are recognizing that the decisions made at all levels of our society have a direct impact on them and their families. Women, especially moms, know they can't stand on the sidelines anymore, we need to raise our hand and be the change we want to see in society, in government.
Moms have something very unique to offer. For most of us, we may not be soldiers on the front lines in the Middle East, but we are soldiers, nonetheless, fighting for our children's future.
Our government is broken; it constantly breaks its promises. Moms don't do that.
What do moms have that the government doesn't have? We have the most primal, fundamental, instinctual force on the earth. We have the "unbreakable promise." The promise of a mom for her family. The "unbreakable promise" that says I will always stand up for you. The "unbreakable promise" that says I will go to the ends of the Earth for you. That, I will never stop fighting for you. The "unbreakable promise" that says I will put my life on the line for you. Period. No questions asked.
The "unbreakable promise" means to us moms that we have to act. We have to use our voice, our vote, and our volunteering to stand up for our children.
For the first time in the history of America, young people are worse off than previous generations. Most parents believe our children's America has its best days BEHIND us.
Abraham Lincoln said, a "Government of the people, by the people, for the people, shall not perish from the Earth." Well, my friends, we ARE the people. We ARE the government. And as Margaret Thatcher said, "If you want something said, ask a man. If you want something done, ask a woman."
This is an updated column I originally wrote for the Colorado Springs Gazette during COVID here, but it seems more relevant than ever in 2024! **[Read the full column here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **STATE**
---
**[Rep. Holtorf details the'good, bad and ugly' of state legislative session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) State Rep. Richard Holtorf, the whip of the Colorado House's Republican Conference, offered review of the recently closed Colorado legislative session in a press statement this week.

**[Rep. Bradley announces town hall meetings to review legislative session, focus on future](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) State Rep. Brandi Bradley has announced a pair of town hall meetings she will host in District 39 to discuss legislative victories, losses and what lies ahead.
**['Devastated' details the deadly fentanyl epidemic and calls Coloradans to action](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Overdoses believed to be driven largely by fentanyl-laced prescription drugs are setting records annually. An effort to share personal stories of tragedy related to fentanyl use and seek solutions will hit theaters this coming week. The film "DEVASTATED: Colorado's Fentanyl Disaster" will premiere in four select theaters from May 15-17.
**[Voters might get chance to tell schools to notify parents of signs their kid is transgender](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** [WESTWORD](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Days after a new state law began allowing Colorado students to choose their names at school, an effort to require parental notification for such behavior started petitioning for the November ballot.

_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[Trump tells Jersey Shore crowd he's being forced to endure 'Biden show trial'](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Sandwiched between his appearances in court, Donald Trump headed on Saturday to the Jersey Shore, where he repeatedly blamed President Biden for the criminal charges he's facing as the presumptive nominees prepare to face off in the November election and called his New York hush money case "a Biden show trial."
**[Top Border Patrol officials say Biden appointees silenced them for years](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The recently retired second in command of the U.S. Border Patrol said the Biden administration intentionally blocked him and others from engaging with the public, enacting robust protocols to sabotage media requests as millions surged across the southern border.
**[Judge Merchan won't allow prosecutors to play 1999 Larry King clip at Trump trial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A New York judge on Friday rejected prosecutors' attempts to enter a 1999 interview between [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)Donald Trump and Larry King into evidence in the ex-president's hush money trial.
_**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[PHOTOS: Aurora borealis lights up the sky around Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) On Friday, May 10, a historic showing of the Aurora Borealis gave many Coloradans a glimpse to scenes unlike which they can traditionally view in the nighttime sky.
**[Denver Migrants Send List Of Demands To Mayor](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ONE AMERICA NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A group of illegal immigrants staying at an encampment in Denver, Colorado, have sent a list of demands to the mayor's office.
**[Boulder County launches $400K pilot program to repair, rehab mobile homes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BIZWEST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Boulder County is using $400,000 in federal funds to launch a pilot program to repair and rehabilitate mobile homes at the Columbine Mobile Home Park and Orchard Grove Mobile Home Park in Boulder.
_**[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[Basile:'Woke' Scouts and the death of another American institution](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Another week, another headline that has millions wondering what has happened to the America of our youth. "Woke" social engineering by the far left appears to have claimed another victim: the Boy Scouts of America.___
**[Brauchler: How best to protect our children in school](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _In a more perfect world, we would not know the name Kendrick Castillo. In a more perfect world, the only son of John and Maria Castillo would be starting a career in robotics after graduating college, driving his jeep all over, attending church with his parents, maybe spending time with someone he met and was sweet on, and generally living the promising life of a man in his early 20s.___
**[Copeland: How to stop wrecking our country](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _President George Washington, wearing a keffiyeh with a Palestinian flag across his shoulders? That 's what anti-Israel agitators recently did to the statue of our founding President, at the university named after him. ___
**[Gaines: Why on Earth was Colorado's AG at a groundbreaking for a Cargill Housing Development?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _I read the Fort Morgan Times article ([follow link](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)) after seeing our AG Phil Weiser tweet about how meaningful it was for him to be out for the groundbreaking of a new housing development sponsored by Cargill and meant to help provide affordable housing to their employees._
**_[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**

The recently retired second in command of the U.S. Border Patrol said the Biden administration intentionally blocked him and others from engaging with the public, enacting robust protocols to sabotage media requests as millions surged across the southern border. We are now in full swing of the campaign. We have an organization. We have fundraising up and running. I'm making the rounds to various Democratic committee teams. Canvassing and post card outreach (gotta reach those "Blank" voters) is in progress. And summer events are opening up.
I wanted to share with you the essence of the message I am carrying to various groups. I hope you will find it compelling.
A Retired Lt. Col., a salesman, a mother of four, a weed lawyer, an Ultra Maga, and a Kangaroo all set out on a journey together.
I wish I had a punch line for you. This is no joke. This is the reality of the Congressional race in NY21.
I'm Paula Collins. I am a cannabis tax attorney.
That means that since the MRTA passed in 2021 I have been traveling around the state, talking to applicants and business owners in our state's newest industry.
Along the way, I learned a lot about the North Country.
When I found out that this is the district where Elise Stefanik is, I asked a friend, "Who is running against her this year?" I knew I needed to do whatever was necessary to support that person. He said, "That's just it Paula. We really don't have a candidate." And I knew I had to get busy and get into action.
For me, this is not a campaign. This is a calling.
You see, I am the candidate on the ballot running against Republican Incumbent Elise Stefanik. **But let 's be honest: the real candidate in this race, up and down the ballot, is our democracy. **I'm humbled to be a place holder for the larger issues that are at play.
Right now, we have a Representative who has gained national attention by aligning herself very closely with the former President. Along the way, she seems to have forgotten about the needs of her constituents. Things like access to health care. Securing new industries to replace some of our Adirondack tourism that needs to transition in light of climate change. Energy sources, and making sure that green energy solutions are affordable and, in the long run, healthy for our communities.
While our current representative hosts inquisitions of the presidents of elite universities, our SUNY schools are facing a $1 billion deficit over the next 10 years.
While our current representative is busy with "Gotcha" politics and calling anyone who questions the Israeli Prime Minister's actions an "anti-semite", the rhetoric from the presumptive nominee of the MAGA party increasingly refers to Hitler and authoritarianism.
For the voters this year, I am nothing, and I am everything.
In some ways, it doesn't matter whether you love me or hate me. I hope you like me, but most of you really don't know me any better than you know the kangaroo - who, by the way, is running as an independent in this race.
On the other hand, to you I am everything. For I am the one person on the ballot who is positioned to draw the line and say, **" From THIS district, the 21st Congressional District, the MAGA mania stops here."**
You need me. And I need you.
Together, we need not set aside the needs and concerns of our district in order to blindly do what Trump says, as happened the vote on the most sweeping immigration reform we had seen since the 1980s, or on the vote to give more aid to Ukraine.
We need not set aside the needs and concerns of our district in favor of Trump's wealthy corporate friends and their trillion-dollar tax breaks while we go through yet another year without reliable and universal broadband.
From this district, we can choose to support the party that gave us the best jobs report we have had in years, limits on prescription drug prices, and an eternal quest to protect our social security.
I'm sure you have many questions for me. Fundraising? - yes it's coming in. This week we have worked hard, and the message is now getting out to donors from around the country.
Organization? Yes - it's me, a campaign manager, a communications director, a volunteer coordinator, two strategy guys and a team of 6 digital and text guys.
Does that matter?
Let me put it this way: I likened this campaign to a journey. But be very clear: we will not pass this way again. **In two years, we will either be in the middle of Biden 's second administration, or we will be in the middle of Trump's second administration.**
This is not the Castelli campaign of two years ago. This is not the Cobb campaign of four years ago. This is not the Aaron Woolf campaign. It's been a long time, and he was much beloved, but this isn't the Bill Owens campaign.
This is a campaign like no other. We need a new approach, and new strategies.
Biden has outraised and out-organized Trump and pollsters and pols still think it will be a close race. But nobody votes for a candidate just because they out-raised their opponent.
This is an election year in which it will all come down to one person, telling another, talking to their neighbors, their co-workers, their crazy cousins, and their grandparents who voted for George Bush, about **the real candidate who is on the ballot, and that is our democracy** and the very future of our country.
And don't just preach. Ask them what's important to them. Ask them if they rely on their social security to live, or could they survive with a 20% cutback -- because the Republicans have promised that's what they will do.
Ask them if they could benefit from a cap on the price of prescription drugs, as the Democrats have managed to do for some drugs, with plans to cap many more drugs as soon as possible.
Ask them if they need to have more doctors and clinics and hospitals in their towns -- closer than the 50-60 mile drive they currently have.
Ask them if they need to see more job opportunities come to the North Country, or are the OK with watching the young people leave for jobs in the cities?
Ask them if they have the option to work from home like so many people in the country do, or does their lack of reliable home WiFi prevent them from having that choice?
And speaking of choice, ask them if they are OK taking away choice from a younger sister, or a daughter, or any young woman whose pregnancy is no longer viable, whose life is in danger, or who realizes she simply does not have the financial resources to raise a child.
Ask them if they are comfortable electing someone to Congress who supported the Insurrectionists that beat and killed police officers during the January 6th riots. (Sidebar: and she accuses me of not supporting the police!)
Donald Trump denies that Joe Biden won the 2020 election. Donald Trump has openly aligned himself with Putin and other authoritarian rulers. Donald Trump has said he will try to find a way to not leave office if he is elected.
And Elise Stefanik? She has aligned herself so closely with Trump that the two are indistinguishable. She stokes the fires of unrest by berating elite university presidents in congressional hearings -- all while ignoring the projected 10 year, $1 billion budget deficit looming over our North Country SUNY schools. She voted against increased border security in the recent immigration bill. She voted against aid to Ukraine. And if Trump signaled to her, she would cut our Social Security benefits and raise the retirement age. You could tell her yourself about all of your concerns, but when is the last time you saw her in the district?
No -- this is not the same campaign we have seen before. We cannot run the same campaign we ran 10 years ago. We cannot even run the same campaign we ran 2 years ago.
This campaign is, and must be, very different. Most of my focus is not with meeting with Democrats. I certainly need to let Democrats know I am on the ballot. But my target person-whom-I-really-need-to-talk-to is the so-called "Blank"voter. The person who is neither a registered Democrat nor are they a registered Republican.
But I need your help.
For starters, if someone shared this with you, I hope you will forward it to someone else. If you have a gathering in your town, whether it's a group of friends or a summer event, please let me know. I'd like to attend.
And please -- have those conversations and ask those questions that I mentioned above. Work through that slightly uncomfortable feeling of discussing politics when you know you disagree with someone. Heck -- if we think we are uncomfortable now discussing politics, just imagine how uncomfortable we will feel if Trump (and Stefanik) win in November.
Democracy is on the ballot. We can all get a little uncomfortable to defend it, can't we?
I hope that I have your support. And I hope I have your vote in November.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zoll6p1bcbo4gh86tc2pfggeqk09tn2t0r5ubsp0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cliecpb2clh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. # TESTIMONY
Can I share a profound testimony that has rocked our world and brought immense joy to my heart? My beloved wife, Nena, has been wrestling with relentless health challenges, including a fierce battle with cancer. In October 2020, we received the devastating news that she had six months to live. We pursued every method outside of chemotherapy. We had some success with alternative treatments, but it was at a cost of $6,000 a month, and we just could not afford it anymore. But today, seven weeks ago, a monumental shift occurred in our lives. Nena underwent stem cell therapy, and the transformation has been nothing short of miraculous. Let me paint a picture of this incredible journey: Firstly, her insulin levels plummeted by a staggering 75%. Now, Nena has been reliant on insulin since childhood, making this a profound and life-changing development. Secondly, her vision, once clouded and aided by bifocals, has been restored to a sharp 20/20. Wrinkles have vanished, and her hair has reclaimed its natural color. Her hemoglobin levels, previously alarmingly low, have shown marked improvement. And most significantly, her cancer has regressed to stage 1 from stage 4. This, my friends, is undeniably a God-sized miracle. We are bursting with gratitude and a deep desire to share this miracle with all of you, our cherished friends and family. On the 23rd of this month, my dear friend Pastor James Fortune will share his wisdom in another enlightening seminar on stem cell therapy. Stem cell therapy isn't just a hope or a promise; it's a reality that has yielded remarkable results across various ailments. From cancer to thyroid issues, weight management to hair regrowth, chemical imbalances to hormone problems, and even autism, stem cell therapy has shown incredible promise of hope. And I assure you, this isn't about a high-pressure sales pitch. We want you to join us, to learn, to share in our joy, and to enjoy a complimentary dinner as a token of our appreciation. If this resonates with you and you seek hope and healing, please fill out the form using the link provided. I promise you an evening of enlightenment, community, and, above all, hope. Together, let's embrace the possibilities of a brighter, healthier tomorrow. Thank you. PS. If you are not in driving distance to LA and you are interested we can come and do a seminar for you in your area. We will even pick up the tab. You will not regret this. ---

| Friends, Virginia's Democratic-led General Assembly and Republican Governor [Glenn Youngki](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O2f3-A065U_YLz49XO4ARNgh9Cv4UEcUfBAhaANFuDDm1N_0Ek9-aI59hjaPo6WuWTO7JW9ozwQp17H_zyjeFOjiJxwWYvUupPSg1mQsT7Tqy0XbVCoDeZuIAsV4r9Uuhq7RH-ExM2KvuXBrYuWefn5cKC5iv-8Z72hR_j-nJRTtXR3hc-r3ZABDiqV24oVP&c=QWAAto7kfw3Hi8cvTbTvhBT7pFds-l2B9T7segCG6qCAW3eHA1W0ug==&ch=sKmd29jrTxKRpc7qft5bGxY0dtX9c3RDWasqPgV6JrVBazDI85M_tQ==)[n](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O2f3-A065U_YLz49XO4ARNgh9Cv4UEcUfBAhaANFuDDm1N_0Ek9-aI59hjaPo6WuWTO7JW9ozwQp17H_zyjeFOjiJxwWYvUupPSg1mQsT7Tqy0XbVCoDeZuIAsV4r9Uuhq7RH-ExM2KvuXBrYuWefn5cKC5iv-8Z72hR_j-nJRTtXR3hc-r3ZABDiqV24oVP&c=QWAAto7kfw3Hi8cvTbTvhBT7pFds-l2B9T7segCG6qCAW3eHA1W0ug==&ch=sKmd29jrTxKRpc7qft5bGxY0dtX9c3RDWasqPgV6JrVBazDI85M_tQ==) have come up with a budget deal compromise that both sides can apparently agree on.
Make sure you tune in TODAY at noon to watch the discussion . You can attend in person by sitting in the Senate or House gallery or you can watch online at [www.virginiageneralassembly.gov. ](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O2f3-A065U_YLz49XO4ARNgh9Cv4UEcUfBAhaANFuDDm1N_0Ek9-aEKMTGG5eI7h_Ha-rK8wOGrdjYbOjcQ_vSPcFBq3ZmK7JX5N0M5AtWeygNyO904vR9zRjRqLsp-rPGuXP2Q1NuPMQ7K2cxMIHbh7jSnST0-qa1Fgpy00Ro1UrJNhcPtOBmELKmU7MPmryxWL5k9m3CMdfHNKm_XEMccco_UDxH0mvVleJmR9QU6axCM1sqFJ1s-05i4pBUFMoydzH50dX6SSi2j2YSnRyA==&c=QWAAto7kfw3Hi8cvTbTvhBT7pFds-l2B9T7segCG6qCAW3eHA1W0ug==&ch=sKmd29jrTxKRpc7qft5bGxY0dtX9c3RDWasqPgV6JrVBazDI85M_tQ==)
Legislators return to Richmond TODAY at noon to a renegotiated budget, which if approved by the General Assembly will go into effect July 1, 2024.
According to Republican Senate Minority Leader Ryan McDougle on 1140 WRVA this morning, senior Virginia lawmakers and Governor Glenn Youngkin have reached a deal on the budget. Now they need the approval of the full General Assembly to approve that budget later today.
[Legislative documents](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O2f3-A065U_YLz49XO4ARNgh9Cv4UEcUfBAhaANFuDDm1N_0Ek9-aI59hjaPo6WugAxPG9vVKhejYYxMoQOBAMEg_3AVa0KrGAm-Z2xhN7d4BD14B34d7KAU2RxyFIImej3xFawzrkuFYPmMGyk3Z2DUUImQ8iETcHioo3Z8rGvqP2DUIkWOWIg_O-Eks8RDf5YQolZyt48=&c=QWAAto7kfw3Hi8cvTbTvhBT7pFds-l2B9T7segCG6qCAW3eHA1W0ug==&ch=sKmd29jrTxKRpc7qft5bGxY0dtX9c3RDWasqPgV6JrVBazDI85M_tQ==) outlining the agreement were released Saturday morning to allow the budget to be voted on today when lawmakers return to Richmond for a special session focused on finishing the budget.
The proposal to increase the state's sales tax to cover digital purchases like streaming subscriptions, music downloads and software was struck from the pending budget after Democratic negotiators concluded they could achieve what they wanted to do without the extra money.
The new budget deal includes state funding to pay for 3% raises for teachers and school support personnel in both years of the budget.
The House budget presentation says the deal "retains all spending items from the conference report," including funding increases for K-12 schools and higher education. Democrats had proposed major increases in what's known as at-risk add-on funding, extra money the state gives to school divisions with high numbers of economically disadvantaged students.
Democrats didn't get priorities like legalizing retail sales of marijuana for recreational use and raising the state's minimum wage to $15 per hour by 2026.
The best news is that the budget won't be linked to RGGI. This program requires electricity producers to purchase allowances for the carbon they emit, and some money raised from those purchases is returned to Virginia and used for flood resiliency and energy efficiency efforts. RGGI is a backdoor tax on Virginians because it allows companies to recoup the costs through customers' energy bills.
The budget scraps nearly $94 million in skill game revenue anticipated for fiscal year 2025, an indication the machines are unlikely to be reactivated by July 1 as many small business owners wanted.

# Governor's Budget Amendments
---
|
* Governor Youngkin has proposed a grand total of 242 amendments to budget bills HB 29 and HB 30. He wants to "preserve the vast majority of spending priorities as passed by the General Assembly."

* Governor Youngkin supports his $64 billion Common Ground Budget which eliminates all proposed tax increases, invests a record $21.2 billion in K-12 education, caps tuition increases at 3%, includes 3% pay raises for teachers and state employees in each year, and increases investments in health and human resources by $3.2 billion over the biennium.

* The budget passed by the Democrat controlled General Assembly eliminated over $850 million of the Governor's priority spending items in the introduced budget and $1 billion of tax relief; the Common Ground budget restores only $230 million of those priorities.

* The Governor's Common Ground budget includes $196 million in additional funding for at-risk students, an additional $1 billion in higher education funding, $175 million for the Housing Trust Fund, toll relief in Hampton Roads, a full funding of the state's share of WMATA's short-term funding needs, and $70 million to expedite projects on Interstate-81.

* Our reserve fund balances are among the best of any state in the nation. We have over $4.6 billion in reserve funds representing 15% of our annual general fund spending. Revenue collections are running ahead of the revenue forecast by $827 million year to date.

* In short, Virginia can fund priorities and maintain our long-term structural balance without raising taxes. The Governor proposed 1 billion in tax relief in his introduced budget, while the budget passed by the General Assembly included tax increases that would cost Virginians $2.6 billion in total. The Governor claims the Common Ground budget allows us to write a clean budget without tax increases or tax decreases.

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/AhItSkFItY8DjTTBilRFcg~~/AARclAA~/RgRoJGzoP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNTEzVwNzcGNCCmYzidNBZu3XGjRSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/AhItSkFItY8DjTTBilRFcg~~/AARclAA~/RgRoJGzoP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNTEzVwNzcGNCCmYzidNBZu3XGjRSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. ## Sec. Blinken Criticizes Israel
Secretary of State Antony Blinken [voiced strong criticism](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAUAH-NvRE9wHwNDF2ypWtH6wGPmBbbEUax2l9fpXPH0y2n-7jNNyy1bPd3XMn3vM8Ye3nSrBiXTEzzNCafiQTJkTw3XGmQmvNx8U6LlKNGC85aa2JOECy54IxwGZ0eixcgJlBcglVawgVzDkRhAkwxxZSGCSiVvrfL5162vlCu3_uT2iXu61j90vvjGOTbIK6DuOJjo_N4qRe0XmKlQVxDLdsXbawcDamyBVc82B1_kDXMuLATG9ME2VoTkgSTDRgExR0EKQ3YTMqOzafHWWothzbDBPcVS_2L6P8u-Q0AAP__snVh7w) of Israel's handling of the war in Gaza Sunday, saying Israel's actions may have violated international humanitarian law. Blinken acknowledged [a State Department report](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D2O2zAQQOHTUB0N_sspWKRR57QphRFnZE5CkYZI29jbL3brrV_z8P29rTfgwvX-Bw6KY28rpMEvWr3UVhq3ugnjTmTIThT1rH1QNmg95ehtmsOmry7tM_rgEbxRVgdU1lHS88TRKOOU11ZdfbDqAvu-EW1OASZMiMIpQh7tvPxrXEemvXy0F52X1I6pxDzGowv7W5hFmGVkylzKVxNmye2gSu8uzAJ4cOU-ThjcqjCLC_6Xdlpuhet_qvLZJTbqdcgML5LYnlsh2QdUhBO7bFXmVpDrXXI_gYqElNqzDtgKCbNMZ8THm0vhHmbh1P0A_v6Yxo9inwEAAP__-GRv5Q) that indicated Israel violated international law, but he also refused to indicate how the U.S. would respond. While Blinken declined to reveal if the Biden administration had a "red line" with Israel, he indicated the White House has deep concern about future military operations in Rafah. The Secretary's statements [seem to contradict earlier statements](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2O6yAUBOCnwR0Wv3ZSUNzGXW67pYU5h-TsEogAxfLbr7zVFtuN5mtG83Fbb54S5ft__0TXY1l96PTG1XKpuTKrGcBFRIV6QCdnaSehJymHh9sM2DmIa1T2OkkEC3EGIfVVRLspGwZySigjrNTiYictRh_jhrgZ4SFAAGBGIFAvdfwslPsDYzrKG-sYynNI7tH7qzH9j6mFqWXf9zFvIePeTmdqeZVEnUL7FfnJTC0NQ8Xu68Fb9x25z73kg2-J8hdmDhgSZWycAHOnePCKwM-KewJOrXpMvIbspZUXNQ3VwWunlKhNMzPi_vSUflb2Pz_7DgAA___r7nHJ) made by President Biden when he said the U.S. would withhold aid should Israel advance on Rafah.
## Police and Grads Flee California
Hundreds of California law enforcement officials [have grown tired](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O2zAQhJ-G6mhwlz-SChV3CNRd2qQzaO7SYkCRBsWzkrcPfPVVA8xPMd-vj-uHTzmV-0-_89JjvfrQ05OvVoKWaK5moCUyI-uBFxjBOqUdwLAto0GgCZEcWZjBWgsGAMLNTNbdZhjSggqNsqDVZJ1WFx_jjflmlKdAgUgYxZR6bZc_NZW-ccz_6pPbJdR9yMvW--MQ-k3gKnA9z_OyH-WVCVy5yM9D4Fr4fEloaWeB6_ZZqDEdskYZ6uOQMTPL4HOKtZXkZa-y81__2vgm399hj2_zb6HXGhIJ_WM_mO6lPzZqAl14fpkY7MigXVRqNt5N82gBIbo4RUtxRIGO06tnhrbQ40w5p8ONwqj77lP-utO_hfs_AAD__xild-Y) of the state's "soft-on-crime" policies and relocated to Texas, according to one media outlet. Police officers now living in Texas said California passed several anti-law enforcement policies that made policing impossible. In Texas, those same officers said they found a renewed purpose. College educated individuals [are also leaving the Golden State](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1ugzAUR_Gngc3InxAGD12ypWtHdLH_Jrc1OAI3tG9ftXP3Ix3p93abbsSZt-WVVviaykSh8hOTE8oIbSfbRp8ADdPCq0G5Xppeqfbu3QwzKidTwGxdstA26H40o7yMQyDZstdSW-mUkRfXG9lRSjMwW0kxxBBjYyUi17J374W3ekfK3-WJvQtlbbO_1_o4GvPS6Gujr-d5dhvO4wQ-foNGXwNlTmXfmEQoOWOBiFh2QNCKnQNth8igJ2-LwFeJn4dQl3FQWrW7j4-Tc-ajHxorl5U4_23rvwg_AQAA___xXl_t). A recent study revealed that California saw a 23% decrease in those residents in 2023. Many citing housing, living costs, and job prospects as their reasons for leaving. Like Texas, Nevada has seen an increase in former Californians. According to a Rasmussen survey, [51% of Nevada residents](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D-L4zAUBPBPI3cy-mfHKVzkCG6OXJPi4BrzIj3F75AlI2lt8u2XLGy35TAwML-_t_kGFCg-_8CKY_VpBltpx7njUnNlZtO40SMq1A2O8iS7XuheymYZxfksjRnwJO3Qm14JNYBXUihjejdY1dCohDKik1oMXa9FC94_EB9GgLPOOseMQEc15fZ_olgX9OGVdsytTWsTxqXWrTB9YWpiajqOo11LfHdMTRj5R2FqWlPEF1NTRghYKlRkaoq4gwOesZDDWAs_IFa-YdoCcp_Tyi0E8ilHAl4TLzVtfE07xec71gUp8-8xyPxykfHf_feV6SlZckxff73F8Ch3hGyXJo9uOygEKv2JGfFcgcLXifoj6WcAAAD__4jgers) want the government to make it more difficult to move there.

Brilliant purple, green, yellow, and pink hues were seen in the night skies worldwide last weekend as severe solar storms enhanced the Northern Lights further south than normal. [See photos of the event here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71u7CAUBp8Gd1j8mm0obuNub5vSAs5hIWLNCsiivH3k1Km-T5piNB_34-5yyefjv3uiHbEeLoz8xkNTLqlQh1rARkSBckHLDdcbkxvnS7JGABgf1CaD9xg08M0wrkO8aSNd9Eu2ggnFNJfspjfJVhejR_SKOQgQAIhiCHnUtn7WfI6EsXzXN7Y11OdSbBrj1Yn8R8ROxD7nXIPvJ85-cSL2615T20jYTlryI41OX6mO2qlr9esEOhLSWVsBIvalWXjNXErumyGKPZ4ul1_Z-DP9JwAA___N9F2H) Powerful geomagnetic storms first arrived on Friday with a historic G5 rating, the highest level on a geomagnetic storm ranking scale. name: Hillsdale College via Defend the Constitution
subject: Religious Liberty is Under Serious Threat
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7d97753e4d2344f7bfcdba358ab4bf57&_e=d-Nki6uLrwhOP7gaUifuDh7q2U1QxUFzxbq07PrMgkngYzLKni5JJIvxClzeW-oqA7-yn6DULEN-8Kn-Us_CLYHgI3rFrAdbhEh5IOVWd_k5-VOhP7XEHhARjhe-i4rd4fomYkesMfmYO7eH6qbu2Z10LA9oOn1lJRdAXZ1czdls2ny8ZpCWQz_exj_0U_NSiMnkrhvhC0IRF5yZ5Ssv8gAB9lbX8f7Q4SF-_igM-DpmJf1ebfdjXmUs13NQv3AElcEb6CcfuFq54uImJbo-yIERK3NetZzqEzI9uhZjWzBiBrSE2t4My-5buxLvYY200g6dw5FgZwKmhWd-v-OnGut31X1AdjMEAoWvnnXtZSp66Wd4iSRQGj4kcFpbGfwZ1GV3EyVljyE7DGqT7XB2Cw%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7d97753e4d2344f7bfcdba358ab4bf57&_e=d-Nki6uLrwhOP7gaUifuDh7q2U1QxUFzxbq07PrMgkngYzLKni5JJIvxClzeW-oqA7-yn6DULEN-8Kn-Us_CLYHgI3rFrAdbhEh5IOVWd_k5-VOhP7XEHhARjhe-i4rd4fomYkesMfmYO7eH6qbu2Z10LA9oOn1lJRdAXZ1czdls2ny8ZpCWQz_exj_0U_NSiMnkrhvhC0IRF5yZ5Ssv8gAB9lbX8f7Q4SF-_igM-DpmJf1ebfdjXmUs13NQv3AEusscJtQ1WiAdfXw5xva4V5V6TrKkMk4vwutV935waa_-hz_q0buBJwSuTUuN2kdW9Srzg-W-MzsEXDaYKOdRN9_S1--nFdsp8ob2idTBrcYUcI2aTcaeRZeAsAPpqpW9vMTbI_qt39lLgYuSgiJ5Rw%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7d97753e4d2344f7bfcdba358ab4bf57&_e=d-Nki6uLrwhOP7gaUifuDh7q2U1QxUFzxbq07PrMgkngYzLKni5JJIvxClzeW-oqA7-yn6DULEN-8Kn-Us_CLYHgI3rFrAdbhEh5IOVWd_k5-VOhP7XEHhARjhe-i4rd4fomYkesMfmYO7eH6qbu2Z10LA9oOn1lJRdAXZ1czdls2ny8ZpCWQz_exj_0U_NSiMnkrhvhC0IRF5yZ5Ssv8gAB9lbX8f7Q4SF-_igM-DpmJf1ebfdjXmUs13NQv3AEPl8SnNQLKEFJXZSHSzPH0EmChgjlmkGnhUxVSXTKdkwDsq5QpZQg9LaUSryzY-ajpbLtRi8gHX2yCYmfLeEG7ZH7En12_Nr-gZ9xJImPwn5ymweJFNIg6Iz5ioZJkejDh2nQJAi1CK5aLIOiiP46Mw%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Defend the Constitution

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called " The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. social problems of the United States-deteriorating education,

values, the crisis in medical care-all have one thing in common.

government.

And yet,
for some reason, more and more Americans look to government as
the solution to their problems.

That's
why I want you to have a free digital copy of Milton Friedman's
Why Government Is the Problem.

In this
eBook, Friedman uses his humble and direct style to:

Analyze the continuing social and economic problems as government
intervention increases in the U.S.

light on the government and its tilt toward special interests
over citizen interests.

changed since he wrote this in 1993, I think you'll find the

body:

---

---
**Your vote matters.
Your vote brings change.
Your vote is the difference maker.

Nebraska...President Donald J. Trump still needs your support.

80,000+ people showed up in New Jersey to rally for him. Will you show up on Primary Day in Nebraska? Send a message to the Democratic Party here and nationally that Nebraska is FOR President Trump. Vote the entire ballot and support our _Constitutional and Platform Republican_ candidates to represent YOUR values in the General Election.

VOTE Tuesday, May 14th and be a part of HISTORY!**
|
#### Good Morning Republicans,

**Verse of the Newsletter:**__Luke 1:45_ You are blessed because you believed that the Lord would do what he said."_

I hope you enjoy some of the content from my earliest newsletters, I believe it is even more relevant as we go to the polls.
* * *

A lot can happen in a week.

We see what is supposed to be a "United" States. I think many Americans genuinely struggle believing that any person of influence or leader in elected office has a proactive answer to what is going on. Secondly, Americans are EXTREMELY concerned that if no leader is being proactive, if no one could SEE any and all of this coming, then how competent are the leaders in REACTING to the increasing chaos.

Worse, if they are a Republican elected official and they **use** the words of the "Values of the Party" to get ELECTED, if it says those values on the palm cards and they say them in their speeches to get ELECTED, why is compromise laced in the "solutions" when they GOVERN? **Why is the compromise of values praised as politically strategic, while in contrast, standing steadfast on integrity and character deemed radical or aggressive?** Why is compromise to moderation always felt by the constituents, but never held accountable TO the policy maker?

Republicans of Nebraska...you are on the leading edge of change within this country. Change within the Republican party. **You have to persist.** You have to know that this is YOUR party again. Patriots from other states are watching Nebraska to see the "how and what" truly brings about change within a party. As Chairman of the NEGOP, I have had the privilege of witnessing the resurgence of our party at the local level. More county parties have become active in the last year than in the _previous decade_. At the local level we see a new dedication and commitment from individuals like you, from grassroots leaders and new members, who share the vision of a party that believes in the people of the party. Your continued support is crucial to building up the county party infrastructure so we can elect **Constitutional and Platform Republicans** at the local level.

_The objective of the party is to maintain the government of, by, and for the people and to further the principles within the community._ The state party must build the apparatus of resources and information for Republican candidates to win. My job as Chairman is to facilitate the relationships and the connection that builds communication of values and support among all Republicans.

_**The voters of Nebraska must choose the winners**_.

A lot of progress can happen in a week.

There are over [900 elected Democrats](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=80a1921e43&e=25844e23a8) in Nebraska and in 2017 there were only 504 elected Democrats. In TWO election cycles they gained **[900 elected Democrats](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=e24ab9fdb2&e=25844e23a8) and it did not happen by accident, but by neglect and complacency.**

Complacency of our Platform Values.
**[](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7b822acd5c&e=25844e23a8)**
**AND WORST OF ALL...Neglect of the voices of the PEOPLE within our party. You, the Republican voter, donor, volunteer and many, many local candidates who were never given the support, acknowledgement, or appreciat ion.**

_WHEN YOU DONATE TO THE PARTY, 100% OF YOUR DONATION GOES TO **BUILD THE PARTY**_! It does NOT go to Federal or State or Legislative candidates. There will be over 100,000 eventual readers of this email and we'd appreciate all 100,000 readers becoming [NEGOP+ Booster Members](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=4d7d489f2e&e=25844e23a8) or even donated $150 just ONE time. A lot of communication can happen in a week.

Constituents (and maybe even you) want the State Party to IMMEDIATELY, yesterday, go make every elected official vote a certain way or budget differently or show support for this cause. I, and the team around me, work every day to make the relationship with all our elected officials stronger so we CAN be your voice. I believe that the elected officials who choose to work WITH the State Party are committed to working with The People. **The elected officials that want that relationship, choose YOU the people, over lobbyists, special interests groups, wealthy donors, or echo chambers that perpetuate their legacies.**

I encourage you to contact all your elected representatives and ask them to network with the county party and the State Party. I encourage you to highlight the importance of working as a team with the new leadership and new vision of the party. I encourage you to stress the importance of having a State Party that is a voice for the people with a proactive political plan.**I encourage this because some of our highest elected officials have declined every offer to connect, every olive branch of support, EVERY... coffee with the chairman.**

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,
---
|

| –Chairman Underwood

A December 8, 1988 New York Times report [reads](https://substack.com/redirect/2f456021-e694-43e0-b55a-31e64af277b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "_Yasir Arafat said today that the Palestine Liberation Organization accepted the existence of the state of Israel_."
This statement was reaffirmed in 1993. This year of 2024 marks 36 years that Palestinian leadership has been unequivocal that they recognize the right of Israel to exist, and seek an equitable and fair two-state solution. Instead, seven American administrations later and Palestinians, and the world, have only seen regression.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.._FIOOywfJ1cOmi2ybk4lc6OxCvU4c3KUy-3PcpjTPUU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144568594)
For example, illegal Israeli settlements have exploded across occupied Palestine from around 100,000 in 1988 to more than 600,000 now, all with seemingly [silent approval](https://substack.com/redirect/b36e77e0-2c9c-45b5-a95b-282a63ef19a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from President Biden, and all with no hint of slowing down.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c29d9a7a-2ad6-4390-b991-9649cc83cf90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Likewise, on May 14, 2018 the United States shifted its embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, contrary to international norms and understanding. This provocation reflected a complete dismissal of Palestinian Muslims living in Palestine and Israel--and indeed dismisses the view held by most of the world. This move ignored Palestinian [Christians](https://substack.com/redirect/5db82666-2b2d-4877-ad95-578181859b04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--who called the move "dangerous and insulting." It also ignored most Jews--[80% of them](https://substack.com/redirect/383aef31-adc2-4c11-8906-c92a9ddc4743?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--who opposed the move from Tel Aviv.
Palestinians have pleaded their humanity with peaceful protest, and instead suffered massive, violent, and disproportionate consequences as a result. The UN reports that during the 2018 Great March for Return, for example:
> Israeli forces responded by shooting tear gas canisters, some of them dropped from drones, rubber bullets and live ammunition, mostly by snipers. As a result, 214 Palestinians, including 46 children, were killed, and over 36,100, including nearly 8,800 children have been injured. One in five of those injured (over 8,000) were hit by live ammunition.[[1]](https://substack.com/redirect/f2f2a69d-c3e3-4bd5-a93d-ef5d3becc0f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) During the same period, one Israeli soldier was killed and seven others were injured during the demonstrations.
These unarmed victims include the disabled and at least eight children, including 8 month old Leila Anwar al-Ghandour.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.._FIOOywfJ1cOmi2ybk4lc6OxCvU4c3KUy-3PcpjTPUU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144568594)
Israel justified the hundreds of Palestinian deaths by claiming it was merely "defending its borders," but this too is a misdirection. More than 75 years after its creation Israel has still not defined its borders, refuses to do so despite repeated demands, and [continues to move them unilaterally](https://substack.com/redirect/d6d5c784-d5c2-4b24-9527-673b9a87c422?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to fit its needs. Neither did the previous, nor has the current White House administration challenged Israel's constant border advancement, even as they lead to more illegal settlements. Instead, the previous administration [profited](https://substack.com/redirect/fc7bb0c9-8c6c-4e2c-9f20-bff7b0bba4ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) off of them.
Still, as recently as 2012, Israel's own Supreme Court ordered the [Israeli government to dismantle its illegal settlements](https://substack.com/redirect/f8593fd4-45c6-4dbd-8e93-da0226511448?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Similarly, the UN Security Council [concluded in 2016](https://substack.com/redirect/76265d16-3284-4f0b-a503-be653e32509f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Israel's establishment of settlements in Palestinian territory occupied since 1967, including East Jerusalem, had no legal validity, constituting a flagrant violation under international law and a major obstacle to the vision of two States living side-by-side in peace and security, within internationally recognized borders.
All of this was to no avail, [as illegal Israeli settlements on Palestinian land continue unabated even now in 2024.](https://substack.com/redirect/ff41d7c9-c5e1-4f1f-b53e-f6068f41470f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And in this current siege on Gaza, one in which the ICJ ruled near unanimously ordering Israel to prevent genocide, critics of Palestine deflect by citing Hamas. As if to ignore Israel's violent decades long military occupation, its refusal to define its boundaries, and its illegal settlements altogether, the focus remains on Hamas in the Gaza strip.
So what _do_ we do about Hamas?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.._FIOOywfJ1cOmi2ybk4lc6OxCvU4c3KUy-3PcpjTPUU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144568594)
**First we must understand the root cause of how Hamas came to be?** It's critical to note that while Israel was created in 1948, Hamas did not exist until nearly 40 years later in 1987. In other words, Hamas is not the historical provocation, it is the reaction. The demands of Palestinians for fairness, equity, and a right to return home far precede Hamas. I've been on and remain on record condemning Hamas's war crimes on October 7, prosecution before the ICC for war crimes, and demanding unconditional return of all hostages. And this brings me to the second point.
**Second, we have to understand how Hamas has persisted?** Accordingly, I have yet to see any meaningful condemnation or accountability of Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu for openly declaring [his efforts to prop up and help fund Hamas](https://substack.com/redirect/01b8f8d3-82bf-458c-a02b-7977605ff002?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to delegitimize the PLO and prevent peaceful resolution. These aren't my words, but that of Israeli leadership and Netanyahu himself, as reported by [The Times of Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/01b8f8d3-82bf-458c-a02b-7977605ff002?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Most of the time, Israeli policy was to treat the Palestinian Authority as a burden and Hamas as an asset. Far-right MK Bezalel Smotrich, now the finance minister in the hardline government and leader of the Religious Zionism party, said so himself in 2015. According to various reports, Netanyahu made a similar point at a Likud faction meeting in early 2019, when he was quoted as saying that those who oppose a Palestinian state should support the transfer of funds to Gaza, because maintaining the separation between the Palestinian Authority in the West Bank and Hamas in Gaza would prevent the establishment of a Palestinian state.
**Third, we have to understand why the current strategy of bombing Gaza into oblivion hasn 't forced Hamas to return the hostages?** Only three hostages have been released due to bombing, and more than 130 due to diplomacy. Therefore, I have yet to see condemnation of [Netanyahu for thwarting hostage release](https://substack.com/redirect/ff160699-9378-40f7-bca1-daa9fa45831c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as attested to by the families of the hostages themselves. They place the failure to release hostages squarely on Netanyahu's shoulders, who rejected an offer by Hamas to release all hostages in exchange to stop an invasion of Gaza. If hostages really were the top priority, then Netanyahu would have availed the opportunity to get them released months ago, demanded prosecution of Hamas at the ICC, and stopped the funding of Hamas. All of that is in Israel's control to pursue, none of it has been pursued by Israel. It is therefore no wonder that Einav Zangauker, whose son Matan is held captive in Gaza, angrily said:
> Netanyahu is leading the State of Israel to complete failure. Stop cooperating, overthrow the government and save the hostages and the country.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.._FIOOywfJ1cOmi2ybk4lc6OxCvU4c3KUy-3PcpjTPUU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144568594)
Repeating "but what about Hamas" without first understanding why it was created, how it continues to be funded, and why the hostages haven't been released, is to ask a question without being willing to apply the proven answer. That gets us no closer to peace, and only perpetuates more war. But that exactly is the path Netanyahu has taken throughout his tenure in Israeli politics.
Indeed, Netanyahu has made no secret of his intent to prevent a Palestinian state at all costs. Again [The Times of Israel reports](https://substack.com/redirect/d55d13e1-307a-4bcc-8248-5a692fdf5fcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Netanyahu boasts of thwarting the establishment of a Palestinian state 'for decades.' PM says his opposition to Palestinian statehood has only intensified since Oct. 7, vows Israel to 'maintain full security control over all territory west of the Jordan River.'
The Times of Israel additionally quotes Netanyahu as [saying](https://substack.com/redirect/8e3134c3-5fca-40ea-9cf1-04260fd78ac3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> I am the only one who will prevent a Palestinian state in Gaza and [the West Bank] after the war.
This destructive rhetoric only emboldens Hamas, harms Palestinians and Israelis, and delays the potential of peace. With each passing day Israeli leadership seems only more emboldened in working to permanently prevent a Palestinian state. But this is nothing new. In December of 1988 when Yasir Arafat publicly declared that the PLO recognizes the right of Israel to exist, the New York Times reported, "_His statement, which he presented as a milestone, was immediately dismissed in Israel and greeted coldly by the United States_."
Nearly four decades later Palestine continues to recognize the right of Israel to exist, yet suffers continued harm and destruction. The peaceful Great March of Return was met with a violent response. The BDS movement has been criminalized in more than 37 states in America. The US Government has cut UNRWA funding despite zero evidence of Palestinian wrongdoing. The US Government has likewise banned the PLO from taking its case to the ICC despite ample evidence of Israeli wrongdoing. Meanwhile, Israeli human rights organization B'TSelem reports that thousands of Palestinians, [including hundreds of children](https://substack.com/redirect/0b6a84db-f456-441c-bb57-828a822163ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), remain indefinitely in Israeli prison without charge or conviction, suffering physical and sexual abuse.
Are they not hostages, too?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.._FIOOywfJ1cOmi2ybk4lc6OxCvU4c3KUy-3PcpjTPUU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144568594)
Palestinians cannot peacefully march, cannot peacefully boycott, cannot peacefully appeal to the ICC, cannot peacefully get UNRWA aid during a famine, cannot peacefully demand the return of their children in Israeli prisons, cannot get accountability for mass graves, and cannot get accountability for being bombed more than 200 times in a safe zone. And meanwhile, Palestinians are expected to negotiate with an occupying force, Israel, which is proudly on record that it will never recognize the right of Palestine to exist, continues to build illegal settlements in the West Bank, and even now is on the cusp of invading Rafah.
Over the past six months alone Israeli bombing has killed 34,000 Palestinians in Gaza, 70% of whom are women and children, and destroyed or damaged all 356 schools and 12 universities in Gaza. The [IDF has killed at least 427 more Palestinians in the West Bank](https://substack.com/redirect/3b5a5dcb-5d4a-43ee-880e-9e22fc4a1b4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and Israeli settler attacks against Palestinians continue to increase. Palestinian Civil defense forces have discovered three mass graves in Gaza of more than 700 bodies, including hospital patients, people who were bound when executed, with some bodies indicating signs of torture and being buried alive. Horrifyingly, the Israeli government has dismissed these atrocities as "[fake news](https://substack.com/redirect/23ee2e79-8cc1-425e-b27d-aec66afdc188?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." World Central Kitchen, the [New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/6a85a311-aaae-4b16-bb8b-076d286f80e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [NBC News](https://substack.com/redirect/6e03a079-f759-4238-8ef5-f1caf9adcac4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) all attest to Israel deliberately bombing and killing Palestinian civilians in areas it specifically ordered them to go to as safe zones--_hundreds of times_. As you might expect, deliberately bombing civilians is a war crime.
Which returns us to answer the original question: No, Israel does not recognize the right of Palestine to exist. Therefore, we must stop operating under the falsehood that Israel is engaged in fair dealing, and ask the right question going forward. Given that Israel refuses to recognize Palestinian statehood and right to self-determination, what will the global community (ahem, the United States) do to ensure meaningful justice and accountability before the next 34,000 Palestinians are killed, before the next 600,000 illegal settlements are built, and before the dream of a Palestinian state is lost forever?

name: Andrew Yang
subject: Thank you
body:
| |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=46fc4fdb27&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Hello, hope that your Spring is off to a great start. It’s hard to believe summer unofficially starts in two weeks on Memorial Day.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=b05fa4c7ac&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
My [TED talk](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=13c34a3a18&e=0f227c2ae3) has been viewed over 500,000 times in the last six days! Thank you to those of you who have shared it around - it’s gotten tremendous feedback. I’m hopeful that it opens people’s eyes to the fact that we can – and must - actually innovate our way out of this political era.

It’s been a constant source of frustration to me that for every 100 stories about how bad things are, so little energy is dedicated to actual solutions that might improve our situation. I hope to help change that.

This week on the podcast I sit down with Zach Graumann to talk about the process leading up to my talk. How do you get asked to do a TED Talk? Does it pay? What do they make you do beforehand? I hope people enjoy the behind-the-scenes look. It was an awesome experience.

Now, it’s going to be time to build on the newfound energy and awareness. Forward will be endorsing a series of candidates shortly, including folks like [John Avlon](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=f434260b76&e=0f227c2ae3) and [John Curtis](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=2685050fee&e=0f227c2ae3). And I’ll be attending the Fairvote Awards in New York City on June 3rd – would you believe there’s actually an event that benefits Ranked Choice Voting? If you’re in New York and would like to attend click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=05a5c34270&e=0f227c2ae3).

Thank you for keeping up with me and believing in our capacity to make things better. I met up today with a volunteer for Forward – he’s one of our state leaders in Florida. He expressed a desire for direction and resources.

It’s a balance, wanting to build a movement that is people-driven and ground up based in communities. Yet most people actually want a vision and some things to achieve. Most of us thrive on having a mission.

An old friend from Iowa reached out after seeing the TED Talk and said, “I see the vision now. I want to help.” I hope that this week has given some new people a sense of what’s possible if enough of us come together. Let’s build as fast as we can; time is precious, the most precious thing we have.

For my podcast interview, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=6eb12a6be0&e=0f227c2ae3). To join Forward click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=15dffb147c&e=0f227c2ae3). To see the TED Talk if you haven’t already done so click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=3160e03539&e=0f227c2ae3) – and please do share it with friends! It’s been a powerful conversation starter.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party
[forwardparty.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=ba268009c8&e=0f227c2ae3)

body:
The answer is Kari Lake.
#

How did I get here?
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-may24.hD4hyN&refcode=em240513-1-160&t=1&akid=2319%2E734936%2EtWmCIy)
**How did I find myself in the middle of the floor of the House of Representatives using my training as a Marine to protect myself and my colleagues?**
How did I get to the point where I was teaching my colleagues how to put on gas masks and regulate their breathing and later teaching my staff how to knock on the door of our office a certain way to signal it was them and not some attacker?
**This was stuff I learned in Iraq when surrounded by insurgents.**
**The truth is, I was ready to fight to protect our democracy on January 6th, but that fight is far from over.**
**Republicans like Kari Lake are willing to do and say anything for political power. They will divide Americans, peddle conspiracy theories and even tear away at the fabric of our democracy if it would help her win an election.**
Abraham Lincoln said, "Let none falter, who thinks he is right, and we may succeed."
**The fight to defend our democracy will not be easy. We will suffer attacks along the way. Some will be personal, some will be to divide us.**
But if we're in this together, we will succeed. We will win this race and keep Kari Lake out of the Senate. But I cannot do it alone.

My fellow Americans - this is Devin Nunes.

It's been a while. A lot's happened since I decided to leave Congress. I'm very excited about everything I'm working on. _**[Do you have a minute? I'd love to fill you in if that's OK.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5ojeeu5kucdb3s9mk39dr07lparbnj3jfpfmk00_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh68ob6c1h2bs "Do you have a minute? ---
| | | [READ MY FULL NOTE](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvvo8ia2vsjfqsmobipfbnbnrtit9kd7c1cek41g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh68ob6c1h2bs "READ MY FULL NOTE")
---
You and I would probably agree that the 2024 election is our very last chance to save the country we both know and love. Our border is under siege, our economy is on life support, our own government is being unleashed against us, free speech is under attack, and our college campuses are operating like Democrat brainwashing machines.

**Look, I cut my teeth shutting down radicals in Congress like Adam Schiff.** My job is a bit different now but the mission is the same - I'm still working 24/7 to save our country before the liberal Democrats drive her into ruin.

_Every day, I take on the propagandists in the Legacy Media. And as a private citizen, I work seven days a week to help Conservatives ..._
1. Save our razor-thin House Majority
2. Win a supermajority in the U.S. Senate
3. Fire Joe Biden and retake the White House

**And frankly, our work is cut out for us.** The liberal Democrats are investing bigger and earlier than we've ever seen in battleground states--the few states that will determine our victory or defeat.

In fact, the liberal Democrats have $150 million ready to unleash at the drop of a hat.

They have socialist billionaires and Hollywood elites on speed dial - there's nothing we can do about that. But we have something even more powerful on our side...

_The numbers._

_**[There are a LOT more of us than there are of them. Unfortunately, that doesn't mean jack if no one steps up when we need them the most.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf59j6p4bqr27aasbntnvj3higijb6j3hd4cgqbo_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh68ob6c1h2bs "There are a LOT more of us than there are of them. Unfortunately, that doesn’t mean jack if no one steps up when we need them the most.")**_

That's why I'm rallying conservatives with my former colleague, Majority Leader Steve Scalise, for the FIRST TIME since leaving Congress. **If this email works like it 's supposed to, we'll have the resources to fully fund all our voter contact programs, get-out-the-vote operations, and door-knocking efforts.**

I'm not asking you to cut a big check. I'm only asking for a small donation before the end of the day. Whether that be five bucks or fifty bucks, I'll leave that up to you - I only ask that everyone seeing this pitches in something...

So what do you say? Will you help us out?

Peter, My name is Yassamin Ansari. I'm a daughter of immigrants, a former senior policy advisor at the United Nations, the first Iranian-American elected to public office in Arizona, and the youngest woman ever elected to the Phoenix City Council — **and I’m running for Congress.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84851428/472849169/995347201?refcode=nn_series_1_img&ms=new_subscriber_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MGUxYzVhZC0zMzExLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AvXwApGJzNUp66OH9V0eyB2Rdj3yWkKRqNJTrz_J8dY=) For the past two years, I've had the honor of serving as a Phoenix City Councilwoman and now the Vice Mayor of Phoenix, representing one of the most diverse districts in the fifth-largest and fastest-growing city in the country. In that time, I've seen the unprecedented challenges facing working families in our community. I've also seen people come together, doing whatever they can to help their friends, family and neighbors build an American dream that often seems increasingly out of reach. **I'm running for Congress to secure a better future for Phoenix, Glendale, and communities like ours across the country.** We deserve real climate action, affordable housing, Medicare for All, and an economy that gives everyone the chance to build a good life for themselves and their families. That's why I've made a career of going head-to-head with corporate polluters, corrupt special interests, and tired, ineffective policies. As a senior policy advisor at the United Nations, I helped deliver the historic Paris Climate Accords and facilitated multiple global climate action summits. Here at home, I've defended reproductive rights, spearheaded Phoenix's first Climate Action Plan, secured over $100 million in new investments to combat homelessness, and brought home millions in free tuition for students seeking good jobs in the trades. That work is just the beginning. Right now, our country is at an inflection point. Our democracy is under attack, it's getting harder than ever to make ends meet, our fundamental right to exist is constantly threatened, and communities like Phoenix are on the front lines of the climate crisis. We need leaders who understand the challenges our community faces, and who will work tirelessly to solve them. [**I'm running for Congress to build a more sustainable, more equitable Phoenix & Glendale — where everyone can thrive, not just the wealthy and well-connected. Folks,

I've reached out to you a couple of times about hitting my May fundraising goal.

Y'all know me and that I never stop working for you and this country. But I have to admit that despite my best efforts... we missed it.

I have one more chance to hit my target by midnight, and I'm counting on you to step up and chip in--[**even if it 's just $1. **](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=becba2ee18a74db28732fe7dd3359771&_e=YXUi8jT1ZUZBSrMdQCcYYTUzHfL84ZOpNm6hCLsr0SdfIhgRwFy3Oa3BStoFzty1GzET3E5jWb7N9TXJrl2t7gd1Tt4WTKrPYcBX8hSMvl7ROxLKoHEE3hakVPCBPzVbe0FC0rMkxHjZMhJb4gHv4dgtvouZlZ0liRaGTwRbzo5_8KYiv5gXXWpPLHZYfmdPyLHEIXZUFhaiwpBHtJSoA_fCoirC0x0e_DGH8wCQK3LVHYGg0tjSytXCOvs-yKS55k7eYirENypQghxSTpghw0pNQv12FxM5QuVqICkbjEs4intIyLujwedn3MGLk32PXjiLYyavdkfoMx-nMA2K5lUEzXBryeLH4gTcTJgFC7BNvV-Jfh0csEtAs0PLcbDFFF_LtPLC0gk2Jdlq7dSACw%3D%3D)

I'm down to my last straw here and scrambling to fix this situation. My team reviewed all the support from the past few days, and I still need just a few more donors from your area.
