You and I would probably agree that the 2024 election is our very last chance to save the country we both know and love. Our border is under siege, our economy is on life support, our own government is being unleashed against us, free speech is under attack, and our college campuses are operating like Democrat brainwashing machines.

**Look, I cut my teeth shutting down radicals in Congress like Adam Schiff.** My job is a bit different now but the mission is the same - I'm still working 24/7 to save our country before the liberal Democrats drive her into ruin.

_Every day, I take on the propagandists in the Legacy Media. And as a private citizen, I work seven days a week to help Conservatives ..._
1. Save our razor-thin House Majority
2. Win a supermajority in the U.S. Senate
3. Fire Joe Biden and retake the White House

**And frankly, our work is cut out for us.** The liberal Democrats are investing bigger and earlier than we've ever seen in battleground states--the few states that will determine our victory or defeat.

In fact, the liberal Democrats have $150 million ready to unleash at the drop of a hat.

They have socialist billionaires and Hollywood elites on speed dial - there's nothing we can do about that. But we have something even more powerful on our side...

_The numbers._

_**[There are a LOT more of us than there are of them. Unfortunately, that doesn't mean jack if no one steps up when we need them the most.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrbd2rt4h7bi4kou36fkof10gu68oakmsr3esddo_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh6ap76c5h2bs "There are a LOT more of us than there are of them. Unfortunately, that doesn’t mean jack if no one steps up when we need them the most.")**_

That's why I'm rallying conservatives with my former colleague, Majority Leader Steve Scalise, for the FIRST TIME since leaving Congress. **If this email works like it 's supposed to, we'll have the resources to fully fund all our voter contact programs, get-out-the-vote operations, and door-knocking efforts.**

I'm not asking you to cut a big check. I'm only asking for a small donation before the end of the day. Whether that be five bucks or fifty bucks, I'll leave that up to you - I only ask that everyone seeing this pitches in something...

So what do you say? Will you help us out?

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

FIRST: NPR and KFF Health News reported that over 100 million Americans carry health care debt.

THEN: Senator Bernie Sanders and I introduced the Medical Debt Cancellation Act, a bill that would cancel all existing medical debt, wipe medical debt from all credit reports, and limit the accrual of future medical debt.

NOW: I’m being attacked by Big Pharma, predatory debt purchasers, and hospitals profiting from the financial suffering of millions of patients.

Before I explain, will you rush a $3 contribution to my campaign to let me know you have my back and keep fighting for an end to medical debt? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/medical-debt-fundraiser?refcode=20240513-lift&amount=3]

DONATE $3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/medical-debt-fundraiser?refcode=20240513-lift&amount=3]

Healthcare is a right, not a privilege. In the world’s wealthiest country, there is no reason people should carry medical debt and face financial ruin just for getting sick or injured.

Now critics are lambasting me with the rhetorical question: “But how will you pay for it?

EASY: RIP Medical Debt has proven that we can wipe out debt for pennies on the dollar. In New York City, they canceled [https://www.nyc.gov/content/getstuffdone/pages/canceling-medical-debt-for-new-yorkers] $2 billion of debt for $18 million.

At that rate, it would cost the United States about $1.75 billion to cancel medical debt.

To put that number into context, the top five most profitable healthcare companies had a gross revenue [https://www.valuepenguin.com/largest-health-insurance-companies] of $623 billion in 2023. That’s about 0.25% of their gross revenue for a single year. So don’t tell me we can’t afford it.

I won’t let Big Pharma and others profit from medical debt, but I need to know that you have my back. Will you rush a contribution to my campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/medical-debt-fundraiser?refcode=20240513-lift]

Thank you for your activism and your support.

In solidarity,
Ro

body:
I helped defeat Hillary Clinton – trust me, I know how to win. And this is how it’s done.

| |

---
| | | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z7o5f19gjsra4k3iahjjg6hrcl159f6rh3qfobt0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs "Kellyanne Conway")
---

Hi, this is Kellyanne Conway!

_[**I have a quick story to tell you, then I 'll let you get back to your day.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z09igt3e59ofet2hm3ej184cdbmsj0d20ukom8n8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs "I have a quick story to tell you, then I’ll let you get back to your day. ")_

Unlike a lot of my friends and colleagues, I didn't just parachute into DC with a fancy job at some white-shoe law firm. I worked my tail off working for a pollster making $8/hour - then I spent decades climbing the ladder, putting my nose to the grindstone, and even launching my own polling firm.

When I became then-candidate Donald Trump's campaign manager, it put everything I learned to the test. The Liberal Media... Hollywood... the so-called political "experts"... everyone was against us.

_Luckily, I cut my teeth taking on Liberals on live TV alongside my friend, Laura Ingraham - the Democrats didn't stand a chance! _

I tell you all this because the odds are stacked against us once again and the pressure is on like never before. Here's what I mean:
** 1. ** Joe Biden and the Democrats are _unloading hundreds of millions of dollars_ on attack ads against President Trump and his top allies in the House.

** 2. ** We're barely hanging onto the House Majority - if we lose just a handful of seats, _Joe Biden will take complete control_ and ram through any radical policy he can dream of.

** 3. ** You know exactly what will happen if Democrats take back control of the House - they'll _grant amnesty to millions of illegal immigrants, eviscerate election security, make Washington DC a state, pack the Supreme Court, and ensnare President Trump and his supporters in endless investigations._
**I didn 't put in years of blood, sweat, and tears to watch our country fall to the Democrats! _[That's why I'm rushing to you with an urgent request: I'm respectfully urging EVERY Conservative I can reach with this email to pitch in a few bucks.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z93p7agfge5e3cikarf1b6qivp8gnm4vqic4cf18_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs "That’s why I’m rushing to you with an urgent request: I’m respectfully urging EVERY Conservative I can reach with this email to pitch in a few bucks. ")_**

Would you be willing to step up when it matters the most?
---
**[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z7n3us06gon7ct06hv5jup7o73lv4mk20r2bhtmo_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs)[**YES >>**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ze8q52q58he6muq7sp9bm7abj1j5kloolgsql7a8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs)_[**NO >>**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zcr57o3jt2bqe628qu9nh14bl7c852gutdmpslb0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs)**
---
If everyone can commit _**[five bucks](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1i2gso248r65ppa3lt6j1t1dfl2q68gv6vjk6ng_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs "five bucks")**_ , we'll have the resources to keep our ads on the airwaves, deploy doorknockers in the field, and fund our voter-contact efforts in battleground states...

If everyone can commit _**[ten bucks](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zghrbg30lkqon51mi9ikv2lii5upckcb0it43sdg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs "ten bucks")**_ , we'll be able to go on offense in every competitive race, greatly expand our get-out-the-vote budgets, and contact more on-the-fence voters in purple districts...

And if everyone can commit _**[fifty bucks](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zm46lnupo0dhpqqsfrk1tq0njbopn275ske8nmk0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs "fifty bucks")**_ , we can knock doors across EVERY swing state, keep our ads on the airwaves through the ENTIRE election, and MAXIMIZE our voter contact programs.

**I helped defeat Hillary Clinton - I know how to win against all odds. Trust me, this is how it's done. **

But all that relies on YOU stepping up. We've stood together before and I know we can win big again. Can I count on you?
---
**[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6qaupkhvpail3q01cmi2bk5ndhket8ga5ri9u7o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs)[**YES >>**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrgtmans5tpscdbh63cavhgmt5kiof0im8c0orno_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs)_[**NO >>**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmrldd95sc7fef8kjki033hhruehui6f20078c1o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cdh66o76c3h2bs)**
---
Thanks for all you do for freedom.

- Kellyanne Conway

Joseph Stalin - "Ideas are far more powerful than guns. We don't let our people have guns. | | We continue to engage with voters across the district to share Tom's messages of effective leadership and common-sense values with local candidates and volunteers through our door knocking program. Recently, our teams have been knocking in towns like _**Bernards**_ , _**Warren**_ , _**Raritan Township**_ , _**Readington**_ , _**Frenchtown**_ , _**Westfield**_ , _**Chester Borough**_ , _**Flemington**_ , and _**Phillipsburg**_. Since our last update, we held our weekly phone banks in Somerset and Hunterdon counties, and launched a weekly phone bank at Morris County HQ. These phone banks last week resulted in over _**13,000 calls**_ made to voters ahead of the primary. We couldn't do it without our dedicated team of volunteers! **Want to get involved? clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update. We are 22 DAYS away from the Primary Election - every day counts and we are increasing our operations across the district! If you live in NJ07, make a plan to vote - either by mail, by using Early Voting, or on Election Day, June 4th. Congressman Kean has had a productive week both in the district and in DC working on your behalf. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! | | Field Update | | | | | We continue to engage with voters across the district to share Tom's messages of effective leadership and common-sense values with local candidates and volunteers through our door knocking program. Recently, our teams have been knocking in towns like Bernards , Warren , Raritan Township , Readington , Frenchtown , Westfield , Chester Borough , Flemington , and Phillipsburg. Since our last update, we held our weekly phone banks in Somerset and Hunterdon counties, and launched a weekly phone bank at Morris County HQ. These phone banks last week resulted in over 13,000 calls made to voters ahead of the primary. We couldn't do it without our dedicated team of volunteers! Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | Volunteer of the Week:John Tober | | | | John is an intern with the Kean for Congress campaign. After what Jessica and Alicia went through, it would have been easy to just walk away and put all this behind them. But they knew they had to take a stand or this would happen to another innocent child, another family, maybe even yours. So, we took Jessica’s daughter’s school to court. We sued them for violating Jessica’s parental rights. And. We. Won. Now they’ll think twice before they keep secrets from other parents in other school districts. But to truly put a stop to this nonsense once and for all, we must win court victories like this in schools all over America. Without the Center for American Liberty’s lawyers and experience, Jessica never would have been able to launch a landmark lawsuit of this magnitude. And you better believe, that’s exactly what the left is counting on. Right now, the left freely targets children and families who are least likely to have the means to fight back. And once they normalize their practice of “transitioning” kids in school and normalize taking kids out of the hands of parents who refuse to go along with these “transitions”... It won’t be long until someone in your family gets called into the school office like Jessica did. It won’t be long until Child Protective Services is knocking on the door of someone you love. Taking these activists to court and making them pay is our most effective weapon. Political pressure and new laws won’t work like dragging an activist into court and subjecting them to the real financial and legal consequences of their actions. They have your taxpayer dollars, the teacher’s union behind them, and all the influence of the sweeping LGBTQ movement and the media. And think about this... | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84869749/472898903/498015156?refcode=mw_em_240513_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NDM3ODhjMy00OTExLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yXs4sGrl_qSTkNNgualdf5EcCfSM6-WU61MjBnr-KQ4=) Derek, I’ve had the honor of being Tim Kaine’s friend since we met at Harvard Law School in 1980. For over 40 years, I’ve watched him wholeheartedly serve Virginia, first as mayor of Richmond, then as my Lieutenant Governor, and later Governor, before serving together in the United States Senate. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84869755/472898907/498015156?refcode=mw_em_240513_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NDM3ODhjMy00OTExLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yXs4sGrl_qSTkNNgualdf5EcCfSM6-WU61MjBnr-KQ4=) (We also make a pretty good band – here’s us jamming at the Floyd Country Store in VA) This means I’ve spent _a lot_ of time with Tim and gathered plenty of intel on him. Here’s the rundown of what’s been going on in Louisiana — and how we’re springing into action: _**FIRST**_ : Lawmakers enacted a more representative congressional map that follows the Voting Rights Act for the upcoming 2024 elections. subject: You, a Nampa conservative?
body:

| | Right when you think you've seen it all...

My challenger, Jeff Agenbroad, just came out of the closet saying he wants to “ _**_allow for abortions_**_ in cases in which the health of the mother is in danger” (which, by the way, is basically never).

Crazy, right?

This gem is straight from [today’s puff piece](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=4b987f8025&e=dea908e0fe "see it") in the notoriously left-leaning Idaho Statesman.

Jeff goes on to argue that:

**"...the culture war bills the Legislature sees each year, like the library book restriction... and several anti-transgender bills... are often unnecessary ‘solutions in search of a problem.’"**

Wait, what?!
* Jeff says we don’t need bills that fight the encroaching woke culture...

* Jeff thinks we should “allow for abortions” yet claims to be pro-life?

* Jeff says we don't need bills (like I helped pass) that shield our kids from porn in libraries...

* Jeff argues that we shouldn't prevent public funding for gender reassignment surgeries...

My take?

_**_Jeff's leftist agenda isn't what Nampa (or, Idaho) needs_**_** _._**

Because babies' lives, traditional family values, and kids are worth fighting for.

If you agree, vote for me, Brian Lenney, next Tuesday, May 21st.

Thanks,

Brian Lenney
Nampa’s Conservative Senator

**P.S.** Agree? Please FWD this text to your Nampa friends!

clean_body: Trump leads in 5 of 6 swing states, with large leads in Georgia & Nevada. Biden is ahead in Wisconsin by 2%, still within the margin of error. | Friend, A new New York Times /Siena poll came out today, and I won’t mince words: This looks bad. Trump leads in 5 of the 6 swing states, with double-digit leads in Georgia and Nevada. Biden is ahead in Wisconsin by 2% but even that is still well within the margin of error. Now for some better news: Polls are just a snapshot. They show us where the electorate is right now, not in November. In other words, we have less than 6 months to turn this around. That’s why my team is building our best, most persuasive campaign yet to defeat Trump. We’re elevating the voices of his former supporters—people who won’t vote for him in November—to reach as many Americans as possible. Their personal stories are the key to our strategy. But we need your help to get them out there. If we’re going to turn these polls around, we need all the support we can get. Sitting on our hands hoping that Trump will lose isn't a strategy. Doom and gloom won’t save us. We need a real plan to keep him out of office. I think we have one, and Thanks, Sarah Longwell | | Republican Accountability, 1100 Vermont Ave. NW, Tenth Floor, Washington, DC 20005 Paid for by the Republican Accountability PAC Inc. Are you feeling the heat? __No, seriously,__ are you feeling the heat? Because it’s not just you... the climate crisis is not a distant threat anymore. It's here, and it's getting worse by the day. **Record-breaking ocean and surface temperatures, devastating wildfires, frequent and severe weather events — all the result of our government’s refusal to take bold action addressing the climate crisis.** This crisis is costing the US over $150 billion a year. The food supply chain is in peril, health systems are strained, and millions of people could be displaced in the coming years. We are not writing this email to scare you, but we are here to remind you that the window to act is closing. **[We need you to implore President Biden to take action by declaring a climate emergency under the National Emergencies Act.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84875555/472912665/1978817996?source=direct_link&referrer=group-jfcp-woa&refcode=ea.db24cf5b-5211-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.db24cf5b-5211-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRiMjRjZjViLTUyMTEtZWYxMS05NmYzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=soCAW5HoNj2OOm37QyotoX1brd0zvpM6l0XqjDyHPDE=&emci=8dc76655-5211-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=db24cf5b-5211-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)** This action would help:
* Reinstate the crude oil export ban
* End new fossil fuel projects and drilling
* Redirect disaster relief funds toward renewable energy in frontline communities
* Fast-track renewable transportation and clean power generation
* Create millions of high-quality union jobs

| [**SIGN ON**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84875556/472912696/1978817996?source=direct_link&referrer=group-jfcp-woa&refcode=ea.db24cf5b-5211-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.db24cf5b-5211-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRiMjRjZjViLTUyMTEtZWYxMS05NmYzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=soCAW5HoNj2OOm37QyotoX1brd0zvpM6l0XqjDyHPDE=&emci=8dc76655-5211-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=db24cf5b-5211-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)

Don’t get us wrong: We made _significant_ progress with the passage of the Inflation Reduction Act, but our elected officials must legislate BOLDER and set policy that reflects the true severity of this emergency. It’s what the science demands.
Declaring a climate emergency will empower us to deny new fossil fuel projects, mandate a phase-out of fossil fuel production on federal lands and waters, and invest in a just transition that protects frontline communities.

name: Sheri at United We Dream Action
subject: My immigration status interfered with my dreams
body:
Our immigration system is designed to keep people living in the shadows. | | | Peter, Growing up in Texas, my dream was to work in the film industry. I always loved movies, and I spent my high school years doing plays, musicals, and video production. I dreamed of studying theater in college and worked hard in my classes to make it happen — graduating as valedictorian in 2012. Even though I auditioned for several theater schools, I was unable to accept admission to any of them because I was undocumented. **But soon after, immigrant youth won DACA!** Because of that, I was able to attend the University of Texas and study theater and filmmaking. It wasn’t always easy. I often felt alone, as one of the only students writing and producing stories with immigrant and LGBTQ protagonists. **However, my UWD community always had my back and helped me feel less alone.** People have been looking out for me my whole life. My parents worked incredibly hard to give me and my siblings a better life. When I was in high school, there were organizers and movement leaders fighting for my rights — unbeknownst to me. They cared for me and my story without ever having met me. Now, I’m honored to pick up that fight and support all immigrants and their stories, whether they realize it or not. That’s why I’m coming to you today. UWDA fights for all immigrants and their stories, and our work is powered by the support of our community — that means folks like you! Our grassroots fundraising efforts are incredibly important, because they power all the work we’re able to do to advance immigrants’ rights. **[So, Peter, can you make a contribution of any amount today to support United We Dream Action’s work? clean_body: Our immigration system is designed to keep people living in the shadows. | | | Peter, Growing up in Texas, my dream was to work in the film industry. I always loved movies, and I spent my high school years doing plays, musicals, and video production. I dreamed of studying theater in college and worked hard in my classes to make it happen — graduating as valedictorian in 2012. Even though I auditioned for several theater schools, I was unable to accept admission to any of them because I was undocumented. But soon after, immigrant youth won DACA! Because of that, I was able to attend the University of Texas and study theater and filmmaking. It wasn’t always easy. I often felt alone, as one of the only students writing and producing stories with immigrant and LGBTQ protagonists. However, my UWD community always had my back and helped me feel less alone. People have been looking out for me my whole life. My parents worked incredibly hard to give me and my siblings a better life. When I was in high school, there were organizers and movement leaders fighting for my rights — unbeknownst to me. They cared for me and my story without ever having met me. Now, I’m honored to pick up that fight and support all immigrants and their stories, whether they realize it or not. That’s why I’m coming to you today. UWDA fights for all immigrants and their stories, and our work is powered by the support of our community — that means folks like you! Our grassroots fundraising efforts are incredibly important, because they power all the work we’re able to do to advance immigrants’ rights. name: Adam Schiff
subject: Fighting fires
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6406%2E5257348%2EzKSJW9 ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Hey Derek,

In 1982, I trained to become a U.S. Forest Service Seasonal Firefighter.

In late summer, I dug fire lines shoulder to shoulder with firefighters in
Southern California as we fought a blazing wildfire.

It taught me respect for fire — its unpredictable and deadly character —
and more importantly, it taught me respect for the men and women who risk
their lives to fight fire.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240513_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6406%2E5257348%2EzKSJW9 ]Adam Schiff as a young firefighter

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240513_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1005&akid=6406%2E5257348%2EzKSJW9 ]Before I continue my story, could you chip in
$10 to my
Senate campaign? I want to share with you why fighting fires matters to me
— but I also want to make sure we have the resources to win this U.S.
Senate election this November.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240513_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1006&akid=6406%2E5257348%2EzKSJW9 ]DONATE
$10

I had quite a few summer jobs to help pay for college and law school. And
even then, I graduated with a lot of student debt that I paid off over the
course of more than a decade. There were some years that my student loan
repayments were more than my rent in Los Angeles...and that’s saying a lot.

That’s why I’ve spent so much of my career focused on expanding Pell
Grants and making community college free. And it’s why I’ve pushed for
President Biden to cancel federal student loan debt.

But this summer job was also formative for me, and one reason that I’ve
spent so much of my time focused on wildfires in Congress.

After the Station Fire in 2009 in the Los Angeles Foothills (in the
northern part of my district) destroyed hundreds of structures and
resulted in the death of two firefighters, I led the charge in Congress to
investigate the cause of the fire, get resources to the Forest Service
that they desperately needed, make policy changes, and invest in wildfire
prevention before the next big one.

By the way — here’s the “Governator” with me inspecting the damage from
that fire and talking to displaced residents (and yes, after finding the
burned remains of a dumbbell, Arnold could not resist a little showing
off):

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240513_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=6406%2E5257348%2EzKSJW9 ]Adam Schiff and Arnold Schwarzenegger

My experience as a seasonal firefighter, and as a Congressman representing
residents who lost their homes, has helped guide me a lot in Congress.

It’s why I fought for millions of federal dollars to buy “night-flying”
helicopters to drop water on raging wildfires and helped change Forest
Service policy which banned night flights for decades.

It’s why I led the charge to renew a satellite program to detect wildfires
before they get out of control and give real-time notice to firefighters.

And it’s why I’ve fought for legislation and resources to combat climate
change — because wildfires are only going to get worse in the coming years
if we fail to act.

While this type of work might not generate headlines or be something the
24-hour news networks deem important, it keeps people safe and makes our
communities better. It’s the kind of work that is so critically important
to me personally, and the reason why I will continue to fight for
legislation that will help us withstand the effects of climate change.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240513_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1008&akid=6406%2E5257348%2EzKSJW9 ]I want to continue this work for years to come, so I’m asking: Can you
chip in
$10 to
help me keep up this work and win this Senate election in November?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2142?c0=may2024_abs_em.VF5JUE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240513_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1009&akid=6406%2E5257348%2EzKSJW9 ]EXPRESS DONATE

Thank you for your support, and remember to always thank your local
firefighters.

— Adam

| | During the Trump administration, it often felt like our country's politics were back in the 19th century – with so much blatant and open corruption. Taxpayer dollars were lavished on unnecessary luxuries, foreign officials organized expensive stays at the President's own hotels to curry favor with him, and prominent political donors were rewarded with patronage positions for which they had no qualifications. The appointment of Postmaster General Louis DeJoy – who had zero qualifications to lead the U.S. Postal Service, but certainly was a top Trump donor – was a product of this pay-for-play environment, and American families and small businesses have been dealing with the fallout ever since. DeJoy became a household name in the lead up to the 2020 presidential election as he deliberately tried to sabotage the USPS and slow down mail-in ballot collection and processing, in the hopes it would award Trump another victory. However, it wasn't just ballots that were affected. Every day, the USPS delivers essentials like medications for millions of people across the country, especially seniors and folks living in rural areas. Now, these services are beginning to be impacted by DeJoy's schemes to consolidate the USPS and cut down on staff and processing facilities. The math is simple: fewer processing facilities and postal workers makes for slower mail and worse service. DeJoy has made it clear his top priority as head of USPS is maximizing profits, not serving the American people. **The results, predictably, have been disastrous.** Since 2020, USPS has delivered _12 billion fewer pieces of mail_ , bringing volume to its lowest level in 40 years. And while Americans continue to wait longer for essential deliveries, the USPS continues to post losses worth billions of dollars. DeJoy's plan has managed to be a failure by every conceivable metric that he set for it. The simple truth of the matter is that Louis DeJoy has shown at every opportunity that he is unfit and unqualified to run the United States Postal Service. If left unchecked, his plans could see the destruction of one of our country's oldest and most important institutions. **For the good of our country and for the USPS, Louis DeJoy must resign.** I will continue to speak out on this critical issue to ensure that our federal agencies deliver the services the American people expect and deserve. clean_body: | | | | During the Trump administration, it often felt like our country's politics were back in the 19th century – with so much blatant and open corruption. Taxpayer dollars were lavished on unnecessary luxuries, foreign officials organized expensive stays at the President's own hotels to curry favor with him, and prominent political donors were rewarded with patronage positions for which they had no qualifications. The appointment of Postmaster General Louis DeJoy – who had zero qualifications to lead the U.S. Postal Service, but certainly was a top Trump donor – was a product of this pay-for-play environment, and American families and small businesses have been dealing with the fallout ever since. DeJoy became a household name in the lead up to the 2020 presidential election as he deliberately tried to sabotage the USPS and slow down mail-in ballot collection and processing, in the hopes it would award Trump another victory. However, it wasn't just ballots that were affected. Every day, the USPS delivers essentials like medications for millions of people across the country, especially seniors and folks living in rural areas. Now, these services are beginning to be impacted by DeJoy's schemes to consolidate the USPS and cut down on staff and processing facilities. The math is simple: fewer processing facilities and postal workers makes for slower mail and worse service. DeJoy has made it clear his top priority as head of USPS is maximizing profits, not serving the American people. The results, predictably, have been disastrous. Since 2020, USPS has delivered 12 billion fewer pieces of mail , bringing volume to its lowest level in 40 years. And while Americans continue to wait longer for essential deliveries, the USPS continues to post losses worth billions of dollars. DeJoy's plan has managed to be a failure by every conceivable metric that he set for it. The simple truth of the matter is that Louis DeJoy has shown at every opportunity that he is unfit and unqualified to run the United States Postal Service. If left unchecked, his plans could see the destruction of one of our country's oldest and most important institutions. For the good of our country and for the USPS, Louis DeJoy must resign. I will continue to speak out on this critical issue to ensure that our federal agencies deliver the services the American people expect and deserve. And if that means leadership must change at them, then so be it. Will you join me? If so, you can support these efforts by clicking the link below:

[https://secure.americancornerstone.org/donate](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=cb485acc5b9141d39c54e9af46c75b1d&_e=taQIPNBZSydoHbQN7T39TraChKMne67Isf1z-ghFiO9PE5qZ1qR79jX2RvLWPc098fksuZQuM7nG4cI2G82_wf-YjGoRL35YHyMBiJMRfFE41LqBlN3qnlpXhNOoYsHRgNYHrp5jDmeBFN5qjKRh_9LUKOwaoxyCphEcnZ91QXZBlIF0Zx0iepPc-k-gzvd3yxqn4Nq2CDifuvzuXIUMAlxWemaocjlDwIhYmN6HYsnxNUWCzWHa-xkzf8KWBTDA4cNLvwWWM-VVoUEULLTz1Nge8rzaM6HODuvlu92_NOTKFdU2lSxjeJKsUGEZhxMGSynja9eiGKK9xVqYxuUeTe990XCN7k5VQm5Qm2WO3Jx0VXVsmv_m8npfn_3owltgDgv4i5PsPqHtfhgpnBSXBA%3D%3D)

Friends,
In the last two weeks, the South Carolina and Missouri Freedom Caucuses made some massive headlines in fights against the Uniparty in their respective legislatures.
The South Carolina legislative session officially came to a close on Thursday and the SC Freedom Caucus ensured that it would end with some fireworks.
First, SCFC Chairman Rep. Adam Morgan [triggered a response](https://substack.com/redirect/136b45ad-8555-441d-a1c9-6de31da34b9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Gov. Henry McMaster when he [discovered](https://substack.com/redirect/93b013ef-1886-4448-9104-fbfc0eb3419d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that a South Carolina Medicaid office was handing out voter registration forms to non-citizens.
Rep. Morgan then tried to amend the state budget to prevent agencies from doing it again but the "Republican supermajority" under RINO Speaker Murrell Smith [blocked it](https://substack.com/redirect/c37b59f5-31dc-4dbf-9e44-7c7806d1a924?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), claiming it was "non-germane" to the budget. A vote to rule the amendment germane was then defeated.
After failing to muster up the willpower to stop illegals from receiving voter registration forms, the RINO leadership in SC found a bigger priority of their own: Creating a new Dr. Fauci in their state.
Given the mess that governments made with "emergency health powers" during COVID, you'd think Republicans would be focused on taking power away from the health bureaucracy. But in South Carolina the RINOs attempted to pass a bill to dramatically restructure the health department. It included the creation of a "health czar" that would be given wide-ranging powers over health policy.
Obviously, the Freedom Caucus said "no way". Led by Rep. Josiah Magnuson, they [used a procedural move](https://substack.com/redirect/94986de9-6263-4e20-8ccf-82e04660f2c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to kill the bill just as the legislature adjourned for the year, sending Speaker Murrell Smith and the rest of the RINO leadership team home with their tail between their legs.
News outlets across the country, such as the [Associated Press](https://substack.com/redirect/002fb644-f14f-4d38-ace5-104e31aabf2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), recognized how big a deal it was.
After failing to get his big government priority passed, Smith then did an [interview](https://substack.com/redirect/5771c1e6-11a5-4704-a282-ddb197732042?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with reporters where he said the SCFC was "harming South Carolinans."
The only thing harming the state is the lack of conservative leadership in the legislature.
**Missouri**
In just their first five months in existence, the Missouri Freedom Caucus has made a splash unlike any other.
We've written in the past about their fight throughout this year's legislative session to pass Initiative Petition (IP) reform in order to stop out-of-state, left-wing dark money from being able to influence ballot measures.
After months of their RINO leadership stalling the bill, MOFC State Senators took matters into their own hands -- and proceeded to break the record for the longest filibuster in Show Me State history.
For 41 long hours, the Missouri Freedom Caucus, led by Sens. Rick Brattin, Bill Eigel, and Denny Hoskins, filibustered budget bills in the Senate until it was guaranteed that IP reform would be brought up for a vote.
It began at 10:30 am on Tuesday, April 30, and concluded at 3:30 am on Thursday, May 2, when the Freedom Caucus secured the commitment of sufficient Republican senators to complete the passage of the IP reform.
Forty-one hours of a non-stop real-life talking, standing, reading from the Bible filibuster.
Let that sink in.
The MO Freedom Caucus also fought like mad to cut wasteful spending in the state budget. When the dust settled, the big spenders in the state senate had to cave, resulting in the first budget since 2009 that actually cut spending in real terms compared to last year's budget.
In addition to IP reform and cutting the budget, the MO Freedom Caucus led the way to expand school choice earlier this year and they defunded Planned Parenthood. All of these issues have been in the pipeline for years - conservative Missouri voters have been demanding them - but it took the launch and the steady, tenacious conviction of a state freedom caucus to make it happen.
That is how hard Freedom Caucuses are willing to fight in order to deliver victories for conservatives.
**50 Swamps Podcast**
In case you missed it, I have also started a brand new podcast called "50 Swamps."
Check out the first two episodes with MOFC State Director Tim Jones and our SFCN Comms Director Greg Price on [YouTube](https://substack.com/redirect/628a840c-8958-48a5-8592-4964c3c541f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Spotify](https://substack.com/redirect/40159d63-2480-46b1-834c-67cb4c542ea0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Apple](https://substack.com/redirect/d7934595-ecb5-487b-8212-846ac43c564f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), or any podcasting platform.

| **MEET JIM**

Gov. Jim Justice is a conservative leader, successful businessman, high school basketball coach, and devoted family man. Before being elected, Gov. Justice led over 100 companies, creating thousands of jobs.

Gov. Justice has delivered on his promise of diversifying West Virginia's economy. He enacted the largest personal income tax cut in state history. He protects traditional values and has been recognized as a pro-life champion, signing more pro-life legislation into law than any governor in state history. As an avid outdoorsman, he vigorously defends the Second Amendment. He is passionate about mentoring young people and serves as the head coach of his local high school basketball team.

Gov. Justice and his wife, First Lady Cathy Justice, have been best friends since high school. They recently celebrated their 46th wedding anniversary. The Governor and the First Lady have two adult children and spend time spoiling four grandchildren. I was on my way to dinner last Wednesday when I got the alert on my phone: Marjorie Taylor Greene moved forward with her threat to try and oust Speaker Mike Johnson. Faced with the prospect of repeating the chaos of last October, Democrats rallied together and SAVED Speaker Johnson – not because they agree with him, but because they know our national security and a functioning government are more important. name: Sarah McBride
subject: 45% are undecided!
body:
45% of primary voters are still undecided, which means this race is anything but over.
#
It probably doesn’t surprise you to hear that we’ve got some pretty interesting polling data.
While we’ve got a strong lead in the poll, what _might_ surprise you is that **45% of primary voters are still undecided** , which means this race is anything but over!
The time until Election Day is running out, and we need to reach as many voters as possible to get our message out across Delaware.
**But it takes resources to do that, and we’re counting on your support to help.**
[**Can you pitch in $5 right now to help us power our voter outreach efforts? Your donation will help us reach undecided voters online, on TV, and on the ground.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240513-1?refcode=em20240513-1&amount=5&refcode2=375_21716_wQFiMV&akid=375%2E21716%2EwQFiMV)
Here are just a few of the things we’re doing to build support for our campaign for Congress:
* **I’m personally traveling to events all over Delaware** to hear from voters and talk about the campaign. I have the miles on my Chevy to prove it!

* **We’re hiring organizers** to knock on doors, make phone calls, and make sure our supporters have a plan to cast their ballots.

* **We’re running ads** to get the word out and make sure folks know about our campaign and learn about my record for getting big things done for workers and families — like passing historic paid leave and gun safety reform.

The enthusiasm we’re seeing for our campaign is phenomenal and the polling backs it up, but with 45% of voters still undecided, we’ve got a long way to go, and we need your help!
[**Reaching undecided voters is critical. So please pitch in $5 today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240513-1?refcode=em20240513-1&amount=5&refcode2=375_21716_wQFiMV&akid=375%2E21716%2EwQFiMV)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240513-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240513-1-375&refcode2=375_21716_wQFiMV&akid=375%2E21716%2EwQFiMV)**
Thanks!
Sarah McBride
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-footer?refcode=em20240513-1&t=1&refcode2=375_21716_wQFiMV&akid=375%2E21716%2EwQFiMV)**

Here’s why that matters: Mitch McConnell will be looking at our report when he decides where to spend his multi-million dollar war chest. If he thinks we’re weak, you can bet he’ll flood the airwaves with even more attacks during the most pivotal moment of our campaign so far.
But if our numbers are strong, we’ll show them that this Senate seat can’t be bought and that we’ve got a grassroots team that’ll fight them every step of the way.

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

It saddens me to see that our education system has been taken over by radicals who push insane political ideologies like CRT, DEI, transgenderism and more on our poor children.

To me, it's common sense that school curriculum needs to be focused on the priority of teaching kids basic subjects such as reading, math, and civics.

How did that basic knowledge seem to get conveniently lost over the years?

You and I know that when it comes to a child's education and health, as well as their moral and religious upbringing, parents are primarily responsible.

That's why I believe parents have the right to steer their children's education, especially when it comes to sensitive subjects and that schools should resist the incorporation of non-academic subjects that fall within the family's purview.

And if you agree with me, then I invite you to use the link below to sign the pledge today.

# Statement from Dan Cox - Vote Tomorrow, May 14, 2024!
May 13, 2024

For Immediate Release
Frederick, Maryland

“We have every confidence that the open seat in Maryland’s 6th district will flip from Democrat to Republican in 2024,” said Dan Cox, Republican candidate for Congress and former Maryland delegate. “I intend to secure that victory as the Republican Party’s nominee for United States House of Representatives.”

“Marylanders are tired of President Biden’s open border policy and his tax and spend measures advancing a woke agenda which is out of touch with mainstream Americans,” Cox elaborated. “As they watch the consequences of Biden’s pro-crime and pro-terrorist policies played out this month on American college campuses, they crave a return to decency and order. I stand with President Trump, the Republican Party’s presumptive nominee for President, in advancing peace through strength, an economy rooted in the free market and constitutional government — all policies which make Americans proud of their nation.”

“As I have traveled my district, I’ve been met with resounding support for my candidacy and platform and expect to prevail in the Republican primary on May 14th.”

Dan Cox will make comments and be available for questions from the Press on Election Day, May 14, at the 11:00 at the Mt. Pleasant Ruritan Club poll, 8101 Crum Road, Walkersville, MD 21793.

name: Amanda Chase
subject: Virginia Legislators Met TODAY for Special Session Called by Governor Youngkin
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Amanda Chase
body:
What happened today?
| | | |
VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY SPECIAL SESSION
BUDGET DEAL PASSED TODAY

---
---
| Friends, Don't shoot the messenger. I'm a retired conservative state senator who served you for 8 years in the Virginia Senate. Unfortunately, I don't have a vote on this budget, but if I did I would have voted "no". That said, I can inform and educate you, which is my desire.
I know how things work in Richmond and my desire to keep you abreast of what's really going on in Richmond. I'm not getting paid to do this. Your generous contributions do help offset my costs and are greatly appreciated. A huge thanks to all who have already donated. So here's what happened today in Richmond.
Today the Virginia General Assembly passed a $188 billion two year budget, which will go into effect July 1, 2024. The House vote was 94-6 with "no" votes from conservatives Freitas, Garrett, Griffin, Oates, Scott, P.A., and Zehr. The Senate vote was 39-1, with McGuire casting the only true conservative "no" vote in the Senate. Here are the highlights. The proposal to increase the state's sales tax to cover digital purchases like streaming subscriptions, music downloads and software was struck from the budget.
Democrats didn't get priorities like legalizing retail sales of marijuana for recreational use and raising the state's minimum wage to $15 per hour by 2026.
The best news is that the budget won't be linked to RGGI. This program requires electricity producers to purchase allowances for the carbon they emit, and some money raised from those purchases is returned to Virginia and used for flood resiliency and energy efficiency efforts. RGGI is a backdoor tax on Virginians because it allows companies to recoup the costs through customers' energy bills.
The budget scraps nearly $94 million in skill game revenue anticipated for fiscal year 2025, an indication the machines are unlikely to be reactivated by July 1 as many small business owners wanted. The legislature will probably meet again before the year is out to address how to handle skill games in Virginia.
The House and Senate both went into recess after acting on the budget, rather than adjourn. So they are not still not finished for the year, despite passing a budget.
By going into recess instead of adjourning for the year, the legislature can call itself back into session to deal with legislation related to electronic skill games and could potentially give all localities the option of raising the sales tax on themselves to pay for school construction.
---
|
---
The budget compromise includes raises of 3% each year for teachers, state employees and state-supported local employees.
It increases state funding of K-12 schools by more than $2 billion and provides more than $200 million to make higher education more affordable by curbing tuition increases.
The approved budget boosts spending for Medicaid and rates paid to personal care attendants and expands services for Virginians with behavioral health disabilities.
The deal provides almost $145 million for the Washington transit system, $100 million in toll relief for drivers in Hampton Roads and, contingent on additional revenue, $175 million for improvements to Interstate 81 in western Virginia.
In addition to passing the budget, the legislature elected eight judges, including three from Hanover County, David Caddell Jr. and Robert Reibach, for eight year terms on the circuit court for the 15th Judicial District; and Lisa Sewell, for a six-year term on the juvenile and domestic relations court for the 15th District.

clean_body: What happened today? | | | | VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY SPECIAL SESSION BUDGET DEAL PASSED TODAY | Friends, Don't shoot the messenger. I'm a retired conservative state senator who served you for 8 years in the Virginia Senate. Unfortunately, I don't have a vote on this budget, but if I did I would have voted "no". That said, I can inform and educate you, which is my desire. I know how things work in Richmond and my desire to keep you abreast of what's really going on in Richmond. I'm not getting paid to do this. Your generous contributions do help offset my costs and are greatly appreciated. A huge thanks to all who have already donated. So here's what happened today in Richmond. Today the Virginia General Assembly passed a $188 billion two year budget, which will go into effect July 1, 2024. The House vote was 94-6 with "no" votes from conservatives Freitas, Garrett, Griffin, Oates, Scott, P.A., and Zehr. The Senate vote was 39-1, with McGuire casting the only true conservative "no" vote in the Senate. Here are the highlights. The proposal to increase the state's sales tax to cover digital purchases like streaming subscriptions, music downloads and software was struck from the budget. Democrats didn't get priorities like legalizing retail sales of marijuana for recreational use and raising the state's minimum wage to $15 per hour by 2026. The best news is that the budget won't be linked to RGGI. This program requires electricity producers to purchase allowances for the carbon they emit, and some money raised from those purchases is returned to Virginia and used for flood resiliency and energy efficiency efforts. RGGI is a backdoor tax on Virginians because it allows companies to recoup the costs through customers' energy bills. The budget scraps nearly $94 million in skill game revenue anticipated for fiscal year 2025, an indication the machines are unlikely to be reactivated by July 1 as many small business owners wanted. The legislature will probably meet again before the year is out to address how to handle skill games in Virginia. The House and Senate both went into recess after acting on the budget, rather than adjourn. So they are not still not finished for the year, despite passing a budget. By going into recess instead of adjourning for the year, the legislature can call itself back into session to deal with legislation related to electronic skill games and could potentially give all localities the option of raising the sales tax on themselves to pay for school construction. | The budget compromise includes raises of 3% each year for teachers, state employees and state-supported local employees. It increases state funding of K-12 schools by more than $2 billion and provides more than $200 million to make higher education more affordable by curbing tuition increases. The approved budget boosts spending for Medicaid and rates paid to personal care attendants and expands services for Virginians with behavioral health disabilities. body:
Here’s an update from a week that included a visit from President Biden, non-citizens voting in local elections, and a look ahead to State Convention. | | | | |
---
Happy Monday!
Here’s an update from a week that included a visit from President Biden, non-citizens voting in local elections, and a look ahead to State Convention.
**Biden Visits Racine County** Joe Biden visited Wisconsin’s First Congressional District last Wednesday. He came to recognize a new Microsoft development in Mount Pleasant and take credit for this private sector investment.
This private sector investment in Wisconsin is good news for workers, but President Biden isn’t responsible for its development. While President Biden tries to take credit for private sectors wins, he continues to avoid talking about his big spending policies that have led to rising costs for working families.
I joined Fox News to talk about Biden’s refusal to address his failed economic policies that has led to a more than **18% rise in the cost of living in Wisconsin**.
[Click Here to Watch the Full Interview](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=aa5378cb15&e=e907534017)
**Non-Citizens Voting in American Elections** Washington D.C. not only **allows** non-citizens to vote, but they’re also **encouraging** non-citizens to vote. I have legislation that would prohibit that from happening.
American elections are for American citizens only. Every American deserves to have confidence in their elections, and it does not instill confidence when we see our nation’s capital encourage non-citizen voting in local elections.
I’m working to hold the D.C. Board of Elections accountable and stop non-citizen voting.
[Click Here to Learn More!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=55a6133361&e=e907534017)
**State Convention** I look forward to attending the Republican Party State Convention in Appleton this weekend. It will be a great opportunity for conservatives to rally, meet, and prepare ahead of the November election.
If you’re interested in attending, there’s still time to register.
[Click Here to Register For Republican Party of Wisconsin Convention](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=46ddb6707c&e=e907534017)

On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

Friend,
Justice delayed is justice denied.
When judicial vacancies are left open on Colorado's federal court, sitting judges are forced to take on a large number of cases, and defendants are left waiting for a free and fair trial.
In the last three years, Michael has worked hard to address this issue by filling open seats on Colorado's federal bench with highly qualified, diverse judges.
Because of Michael’s work with Senator John Hickenlooper, President Biden has appointed five highly qualified, diverse judges to the seven-judge bench — and Colorado is no longer in a “judicial emergency.”
You can read more about his work on judicial nominees here >> [https://gazette.com/colorado_politics/bennet-hickenlooper-court-how-2-senators-left-their-mark-on-court/article_a94d8002-1e4d-515e-9470-b766fdbde131.html]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_051324_JudicialNoms_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_051324_JudicialNoms_act]
With these nominations, Michael made it a point to find the best candidates with diverse experiences and backgrounds.
He's worked to put more women and people of color on Colorado's federal bench and to recommend nominees from all parts of Colorado with experience in different areas of the law.
For the first time, Colorado will have a district judge based outside of Denver. Judge Gordon P. Gallagher, from the Western Slope, will be stationed in Grand Junction. Upon her confirmation, Judge Charlotte Sweeney became the first openly LGBT woman to serve as a federal judge west of the Mississippi River. And Judge Kato Crews is the only active African American judge on Colorado's District Court.
Thanks to Michael’s hard work, Colorado has become one of the most effective states at filling judicial vacancies. Your grassroots support helps Michael continue to make progress for Colorado. clean_body: [] Friend, Justice delayed is justice denied. When judicial vacancies are left open on Colorado's federal court, sitting judges are forced to take on a large number of cases, and defendants are left waiting for a free and fair trial. In the last three years, Michael has worked hard to address this issue by filling open seats on Colorado's federal bench with highly qualified, diverse judges. Because of Michael’s work with Senator John Hickenlooper, President Biden has appointed five highly qualified, diverse judges to the seven-judge bench — and Colorado is no longer in a “judicial emergency.” You can read more about his work on judicial nominees here >> [] [] With these nominations, Michael made it a point to find the best candidates with diverse experiences and backgrounds. He's worked to put more women and people of color on Colorado's federal bench and to recommend nominees from all parts of Colorado with experience in different areas of the law. For the first time, Colorado will have a district judge based outside of Denver. Judge Gordon P. Gallagher, from the Western Slope, will be stationed in Grand Junction. Upon her confirmation, Judge Charlotte Sweeney became the first openly LGBT woman to serve as a federal judge west of the Mississippi River. And Judge Kato Crews is the only active African American judge on Colorado's District Court. Thanks to Michael’s hard work, Colorado has become one of the most effective states at filling judicial vacancies. Your grassroots support helps Michael continue to make progress for Colorado. | Peter,

While our election isn’t until 2025, the 2024 election will be one of the most consequential elections of our lifetime. **The battle for control of the U.S. House is at the center of that challenge.**

Without a Democratic majority in the House, far-right extremists could try to derail the certification of the 2024 presidential election – just like they tried to do on January 6, 2021.

When I announced my run for Governor, multiple qualified Democratic candidates stepped forward to run in our very competitive district.

**While we must wait until the June primary to know who our VA-07 Democratic nominee will be, we don’t need to wait to support them! **Since I flipped this district in 2018, National Republicans have poured millions of dollars into attack ads, and we must ensure the VA-07 nominee has the funds they need to hold this seat! Update on General District Court Case
| | |
---
| Friends, Today I was vindicated. As many of you know, back in March, I was criminally charged with assault and battery by the girlfriend of a vindictive former security employee's girlfriend. Thankfully, today I was vindicated; I was not convicted.
His girlfriend also sought to take my guns away in General District Court through a permanent protective order. Thankfully, justice prevailed and the judge denied her request.
Today's win in court was a huge relief, especially after watching the kangaroo courts handle President Trump's legal proceedings.
Thanks to all witnesses who came out today to testify and to those who contributed to my legal fund to help offset the legal costs.
I'm so relieved to have this behind me so that I can continue to focus on serving the people of the Commonwealth.
I hope you will join me on Friday, June 28 for our annual Lincoln Reagan Day dinner with many special guests. You don't want to miss it. Get your tickets today and let's focus on getting Republicans elected.

Dear Friend, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v2zAMQH8NfbNBUaJVH3xYpjiHtkGRDhh2MmRJbjRYtesPZP33g4Nu18cHks-maYj9Zw36AETX6BcgAvkNiD5-3dK8_U6PpxwfT3_yj_KceJ_SdyBaP6fwX_3aUoRk47BTbTJfy96jykIttOBSaomcXesuBG1LZLTOoeO-EuyqBylVb1lKiVmsCUkhC0mCGVUhNbPGrvOsSm1ZgML7ncKmMEdnxbLe7DyPYyrcmLKhvq7rtNwfa4CaJbhtDoV9D35cdwOoGcLge6CmwmCdZc471j5XyDrvRMC8456rvqxQhweQzbamdhm32QWQ5mBO-eV4Bip3nIKPWwJpjs9fxNk02fj2DtL8C2kP5tQ-HZ9M074-m5eX9nI8t68_8p-XbK79dIvDEJdSg8K3e5gb098AAAD__4T9eV0)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner’s life that afternoon – and probably his own. **But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric’s case – exhausting his options through the justice system. _Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_ **A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric’s last remaining options for freedom.** **[Now you know why I’m asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v2zAMQH8NfbNBUaJVH3xYpjiHtkGRDhh2MmRJbjRYtesPZP33g4Nu18cHks-maYj9Zw36AETX6BcgAvkNiD5-3dK8_U6PpxwfT3_yj_KceJ_SdyBaP6fwX_3aUoRk47BTbTJfy96jykIttOBSaomcXesuBG1LZLTOoeO-EuyqBylVb1lKiVmsCUkhC0mCGVUhNbPGrvOsSm1ZgML7ncKmMEdnxbLe7DyPYyrcmLKhvq7rtNwfa4CaJbhtDoV9D35cdwOoGcLge6CmwmCdZc471j5XyDrvRMC8456rvqxQhweQzbamdhm32QWQ5mBO-eV4Bip3nIKPWwJpjs9fxNk02fj2DtL8C2kP5tQ-HZ9M074-m5eX9nI8t68_8p-XbK79dIvDEJdSg8K3e5gb098AAAD__4T9eV0)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I’m proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund – a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George’s County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book – including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect’s civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials – in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me – I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones – not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense – but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name. That’s why I can’t turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. **And I hope you won’t either.** **[**Will you sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Missouri Governor Mike Parson right away?**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v2zAMQH8NfbNBUaJVH3xYpjiHtkGRDhh2MmRJbjRYtesPZP33g4Nu18cHks-maYj9Zw36AETX6BcgAvkNiD5-3dK8_U6PpxwfT3_yj_KceJ_SdyBaP6fwX_3aUoRk47BTbTJfy96jykIttOBSaomcXesuBG1LZLTOoeO-EuyqBylVb1lKiVmsCUkhC0mCGVUhNbPGrvOsSm1ZgML7ncKmMEdnxbLe7DyPYyrcmLKhvq7rtNwfa4CaJbhtDoV9D35cdwOoGcLge6CmwmCdZc471j5XyDrvRMC8456rvqxQhweQzbamdhm32QWQ5mBO-eV4Bip3nIKPWwJpjs9fxNk02fj2DtL8C2kP5tQ-HZ9M074-m5eX9nI8t68_8p-XbK79dIvDEJdSg8K3e5gb098AAAD__4T9eV0)** Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can’t get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head. But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. **[So please, won’t you take just 30 seconds of your time right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Governor Mike Parson?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j01v2zAMQH8NfbNBUaJVH3xYpjiHtkGRDhh2MmRJbjRYtesPZP33g4Nu18cHks-maYj9Zw36AETX6BcgAvkNiD5-3dK8_U6PpxwfT3_yj_KceJ_SdyBaP6fwX_3aUoRk47BTbTJfy96jykIttOBSaomcXesuBG1LZLTOoeO-EuyqBylVb1lKiVmsCUkhC0mCGVUhNbPGrvOsSm1ZgML7ncKmMEdnxbLe7DyPYyrcmLKhvq7rtNwfa4CaJbhtDoV9D35cdwOoGcLge6CmwmCdZc471j5XyDrvRMC8456rvqxQhweQzbamdhm32QWQ5mBO-eV4Bip3nIKPWwJpjs9fxNk02fj2DtL8C2kP5tQ-HZ9M074-m5eX9nI8t68_8p-XbK79dIvDEJdSg8K3e5gb098AAAD__4T9eV0)** After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support. No doubt Eric saved his partner’s life that afternoon – and probably his own. But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench. Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric’s case – exhausting his options through the justice system. Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won! A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric’s last remaining options for freedom. My name is Stephanie Mohr and I’m proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund – a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George’s County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book – including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect’s civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials – in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me – I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones – not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense – but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name. That’s why I can’t turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. And I hope you won’t either. Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can’t get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head. But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support. Remember, LELDF is able to support wrongly accused and convicted officers like Eric and me because of the generosity of patriots like you. And with a pardon the final option to secure Eric’s freedom and restore his good name, I’m begging you to Thank you in advance for your support. | | Gratefully, Stephanie Mohr Director, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund P.S. Without your immediate action, Eric DeValkenaere – a decorated Kansas City Police Detective – will spend the next six years behind bars. His three beautiful children won’t have their biggest cheerleader at their graduations, maybe even their weddings. And the only way to get him out is to get Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon him. I hope you’ll also make a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF. No matter what, please pray for Eric and his heartbroken family. | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter! | | | ---|---|--- © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303 |

clean_body: Gerrymandering was born with one goal in mind | Friends, We’re going to say something that really, really shouldn’t be controversial: Gerrymandering is cheating! Now louder for the people in the back... In all seriousness, the concept of gerrymandering was born with one goal in mind: to silence the will of the voters. Support is growing every day to end partisan gerrymandering for good. And new polling shows that the top issue influencing people’s votes heading into the 2024 election is protecting democracy. But still, there are plenty of powerful forces in our country that will do anything they can to keep their white-knuckle grip on power. body:
We need you now or we might not make it.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0513_ny_ba_appeal_2_weeks&n=1)
---
Peter, **Right now our campaign is fighting an intense battle against the biggest challenge we’ve faced yet.** We need tens of thousands more signatures to get on the ballot in New York - and with just two weeks left, we’re behind where we need to be. **From the bottom of my heart, I’m asking every one of you to[do whatever you can ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0513_ny_ba_appeal_2_weeks&n=2)**[**_now_**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0513_ny_ba_appeal_2_weeks&n=3)**[to help us get on the ballot in New York](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0513_ny_ba_appeal_2_weeks&n=4) and keep us on track to put an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action campaign on _every single ballot_ across the country.**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0513_ny_ba_appeal_2_weeks&n=5 "HELP JILL GET ON THE NY BALLOT") [HELP JILL GET ON THE NY BALLOT](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0513_ny_ba_appeal_2_weeks&n=5)
---
**Genocide in Gaza is going off the charts right now with the assault on Rafah,** where 1.4 million people have been herded like cattle and are now targeted like fish in a barrel - including 600,000 wounded, malnourished, sick, traumatized children. With Israel's closure of the Rafah crossing last week choking off the little water and food that were getting in, and bombing the entire Gaza strip, **this is a grand finale to 75 years of ethnic cleansing.** **We must do everything in our power to shut this genocide down. That means turning up the political demand by getting our opposition to genocide on the ballot in New York - ensuring this is a national force that cannot be stopped!** To make that happen, we _urgently_ need volunteers as well as people who would like to get paid to petition. If you can come, let us know and we’ll get in touch to make arrangements for your visit, including accommodations if you need them. If you live within a bus ride of New York, and need help getting there, we can help you get there. We also need folks in NY or nearby who can provide housing or transportation for petitioners. **However you can help, please sign up now:**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0513_ny_ba_appeal_2_weeks&n=6 "HELP JILL GET ON THE NY BALLOT") [HELP JILL GET ON THE NY BALLOT](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0513_ny_ba_appeal_2_weeks&n=6)

name: Powered By People
subject: Did you see Beto's email?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

Did you see Beto’s email from Friday? Tomorrow, he’s hosting a virtual
call to talk through Powered by People’s work and how you can get
involved.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63453?t=1001&akid=239582%2E444211%2EVR5sd_ ]Will you join Beto tomorrow night at 6:30pm CDT?

In an election year where control of the Presidency, Senate, and the House
will be determined, we need as many people as possible to join our
efforts.

Please read Beto’s email below and then join us tomorrow night!

Thank you!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

I am hosting a call this coming Tuesday, May 14th to give you a chance to
join us in registering Texas voters. I’ll explain how our program works,
how it’s different from anything else in Texas (or the rest of the country
for that matter) and how you can play a leading role in signing up voters
who can make the difference in close elections across the state.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63453?t=1002&akid=239582%2E444211%2EVR5sd_ ]Sign up here to join us on Tuesday.

But first, you might be wondering, does voter registration even work? Is
it the most effective thing we can be doing with our time?

The short answer:
Yes. And yes.

The longer answer:
More Democratic voters mean more opportunities for Democratic candidates
to win. But until now, there has not been a consistent, effective and
partisan voter registration effort in Texas.

That means Democratic campaigns are forced to focus exclusively on
already-registered voters, many millions of whom do not vote for whatever
reason (we don’t have good contact information for them; they no longer
care about elections; or they are unable to overcome the most aggressive
voter suppression in the country). Relying on the already-registered
electorate keeps us coming up short in crucial races.

It also means that the non-partisan voter registration efforts that do
take place in Texas are adding both Democrats and Republicans to the voter
rolls. The cost of being non-profit and non-partisan is that you can’t
target based on party affiliation. In a state that is so dominated by
Republicans who have so radically tilted the playing field to their
advantage, we can’t afford that either.

Powered by People is different. We are a partisan political organization
with one mission: electing Democrats to office in Texas. Our program
focuses on registering likely Democrats and then, importantly, staying in
touch with these newly registered voters ahead of November so that they
are much more likely to vote. The partisan screening and personal follow
up set us apart and, if we have enough volunteers working with us over the
coming months, will help set Democratic candidates up for success.

Another question you might have for me, will this work?

The honest answer:
It depends.

We’ve tested this partisan registration and relationship-building program
with a small group of dedicated volunteers for the last two months and the
results have been promising. We are registering Democrats at a strong clip
and have successfully maintained contact with them after registration.

But whether we can reach a scale that will make the difference in key
elections across the state depends on how many volunteers sign up to do
the work. And to be clear, the work isn’t easy. It involves training,
teamwork and a willingness to meet future voters wherever they are:
college campuses, concerts, parks, among other public spaces. But I am
confident that it is the work that will make the greatest difference over
time.

I’ve always said that winning in Texas is a matter of time and effort. The
more of us willing to put in the effort, the sooner we’ll be there.

Now, a question for you: how long do you want to wait?

See you Tuesday,

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1003&akid=239582%2E444211%2EVR5sd_

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Untitled%20design.png]
We have big news to re-share.
Thanks to Senator Peters, Postmaster General Louis DeJoy is pausing changes planned at the Iron Mountain Processing Center that would move a portion of mail processing operations to a facility in Green Bay.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
Friends,
I will work hard in Congress to ensure that I am as strong a fighter as Sen. Peters for Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula.
As I've said before, Democrats and Republicans must unite in the effort to stop the so-called modernization plan for the USPS in Kingsford.
Kingsford's service and that of all postal workers is crucial for the UP. These workers have done great work delivering our mail, and we rely on them for our connection.
Although the Postmaster General claimed that the modernization plan would reduce costs and improve mail delivery for Yoopers and across the country, many people, including myself, strongly disagreed.
The mounting bipartisan pressure from lawmakers, watchdogs, unions, citizens, and the postal service's own governing boards — all united in stating that USPS should halt its controversial reform plan to overhaul the agency, has led to a significant victory tonight. This is a testament to our collective strength and determination.
For months, the Postmaster General remained defiant and refused to pause. Today, Peters secured a pause.
But, we are not done yet.
We must continue to demand the Postal Regulatory Commission can thoroughly assess its impacts on Yoopers. Our fight is far from over, but with your continued support, we can make a difference.
Your support, generosity, and loyalty are not just appreciated; they are crucial. They can help me get to Congress so I, too, can hold those who aren't looking out for our shared interests to account. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
Onward,
-Bob
